problem: 分析 2010 年至今的黄金走势，用思维导图告诉我黄金未来有可能的趋势，关键压力，关键支撑位置
final_response:
<think>
<answer>以下为2010年至今的黄金走势分析及未来趋势、关键压力与支撑的思维导图文本描述。如需图形化版本，可将本内容粘贴至XMind等工具导入。

一、历史走势分析
1. 2010–2015：震荡上行
- 2010年8月触底1,340美元/盎司后开启牛市，主要受益于美联储量化宽松、美元走弱及避险需求（如欧洲债务危机）<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite><cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。
- 2013年“缩减恐慌”期间金价短暂回调，但2015年末突破1,400美元/盎司，年化涨幅约25%<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。

2. 2016–2020：结构性牛市
- 2016年1月突破1,300美元/盎司后持续上涨，2018年1月见顶1,370美元/盎司，期间美联储加息周期与美元阶段性走强未显著压制金价<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。
- 2019年金价重返1,500美元/盎司，全年涨幅约10%<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。
- 2020年疫情冲击下金价飙升，3月一度突破2,075美元/盎司，年化涨幅超30%，体现避险需求与流动性注入的双重驱动<cite id="call_03c8e563ab6f-0"></cite><cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。

3. 2021–2024：高位震荡与再创新高
- 2021年金价维持在1,800–2,000美元区间，全年波动率收窄，反映市场对通胀预期的消化<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。
- 2022年美联储激进加息期间金价承压，但全年仍录得约10%涨幅，体现央行购金与地缘政治风险的支撑<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。
- 2023年金价维持在1,900–2,200美元区间，全年波动率较低，反映市场对利率路径的定价趋于稳定<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。
- 2024年金价再创新高，全年需求创纪录，推动金价突破2,300美元/盎司，反映央行购金加速与投资需求强劲<cite id="call_690ba1dec11b-0"></cite><cite id="call_690ba1dec11b-1"></cite>。

二、驱动因素总结
1. 货币与信用扩张
- 美联储资产负债表扩张、量化宽松及负利率政策持续支撑金价，尤其在美元走弱时更为显著<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite><cite id="call_10"></cite>。

2. 央行购金
- 2015–2024年央行购金量年均超1,000吨，2022–2024年加速至1,500吨以上，反映去美元化与储备多元化趋势<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite>。

3. 投资需求
- 黄金ETF与ETF-黄金需求年化增长超100%，2024年投资需求再创新高，推动金价突破历史高点<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite><cite id="call_690ba1dec11b-1"></cite>。

4. 避险与通胀对冲
- 地缘政治风险（如俄乌冲突、中东局势）及通胀预期反复支撑金价，尤其在市场波动加剧时金价表现优于股市<cite id="call_03c8e563ab6f-0"></cite><cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite>。

5. 工业与珠宝需求
- 珠宝需求占全球需求约40%，工业需求（电子等）支撑金价底部弹性，但高金价抑制珠宝需求（2024年需求边际放缓）<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite><cite id="call_690ba1dec11b-2"></cite>。

三、未来趋势（思维导图分支）
1. 趋势判断
- 结构性牛市延续：央行购金、去美元化、投资需求强劲及地缘风险持续构成支撑，金价中枢上移<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite><cite id="call_690ba1dec11b-1"></cite>。
- 波动率分化：在利率路径清晰后波动率收窄，但地缘与政策不确定性仍可能引发阶段性波动<cite id="call_03c8e563ab6f-0"></cite>。

2. 关键压力位（阻力位）
- 短期（1–3个月）：2,400–2,500美元/盎司（2024年10月ETF需求爆发后的心理关口）<cite id="call_690ba1dec11b-4"></cite>。
- 中期（3–6个月）：2,600–2,700美元/盎司（2020年3月高点上方约10–15%）<cite id="call_03c8e563ab6f-0"></cite>。
- 长期（6–12个月）：3,000–3,200美元/盎司（历史高点与央行购金加速下的潜在目标）<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite>。

3. 关键支撑位
- 短期（1–3个月）：2,200–2,300美元/盎司（2023年震荡中枢下沿）<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。
- 中期（3–6个月）：2,000–2,100美元/盎司（2020年低点上方约10–15%）<cite id="call_03c8e563ab6f-0"></cite>。
- 长期（6–12个月）：1,800–1,900美元/盎司（2021年震荡中枢下沿）<cite id="call_b84ebf71e705-0"></cite>。

四、情景分析（可选分支）
1. 情景一：鹰派转向（美联储超预期加息）
- 金价承压，短期回调至2,000–2,100美元支撑，但若通胀黏性较强，回调后可能重新测试2,300美元上方<cite id="call_03c8e563ab6f-0"></cite>。

2. 情景二：鸽派预期升温（降息或暂停加息）
- 金价突破2,500–2,600美元压力，测试3,000美元目标，央行购金加速提供支撑<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite>。

3. 情景三：地缘冲突升级
- 金价快速上探2,600–2,700美元压力，若冲突持续可能突破3,000美元<cite id="call_c6c9201b5aae-0"></cite>。

五、不确定性提示
- 利率路径与通胀实际表现可能改变金价节奏，需密切跟踪美联储政策与CPI数据<cite id="call_10"></cite>。
- 珠宝需求疲软可能限制金价涨幅，但央行购金与ETF需求强劲提供底部支撑<cite id="call_690ba1dec11b-2"></cite>。

注：以上压力与支撑位为技术参考，实际交易需结合成交量、波动率及宏观信号综合判断。</answer>

In recent years, central banks have been buying gold at record levels, exceeding 1,000 metric tons annually in 2022 and 2023. This trend reflects efforts by many countries to reduce reliance on the U.S. dollar (especially after events like the freezing of Russia's reserves in 2022) and to bolster financial stability with an asset no one government can debase. Gold's status as a reserve asset underscores the trust central banks place in its enduring value. Industrial and Cultural Demand: Beyond investment, gold retains significant demand in jewelry and certain industries. Approximately half of global gold demand comes from jewelry fabrication – a testament to gold's cultural importance as a symbol of wealth and prosperity (particularly in countries like India and China). raw_output.raw_text: <search query="Gold price 2010 to 2020 historical data source" search_time="2026年5月10日9时46分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:76"><title>The Golden Hedge: From Global Financial Crisis to Global Pandemic</title><summary>This paper examines whether gold, and gold mining stocks, were an effective hedge during the 2020 global pandemic and 2008-2009 global financial crisis. Prior research suggests that gold’s hedging value is most evident during crisis periods, but none has compared the 2008-2009 and 2020 episodes directly. Dynamic conditional correlations and hedge ratios are estimated to determine the impact of rising market volatility on the hedging properties of physical gold and gold mining stocks. The results suggest that gold provided strong hedging value during the global financial crisis but did not consistently exhibit this property in 2020. There was less scope for hedging against losses in 2020 because the market recovered so quickly from the March 2020 lows. This contrasts with the extended stock market weakness following the onset of the global financial crisis.</summary><hostname>ResearchGate</hostname><publisher>Economic Modelling</publisher><author_list><author name="Richard C K Burdekin" affiliation="Claremont McKenna College" /><author name="Ran Tao" affiliation="University of Wisconsin, Whitewater, and Lake Forest College" /></author_list><url>https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Richard-Burdekin/publication/347256603_The_Golden_Hedge_From_Global_Financial_Crisis_to_Global_Pandemic/links/5fd8ed1945851553a0bd5451/The-Golden-Hedge-From-Global-Financial-Crisis-to-Global-Pandemic.pdf</url><publish_time>2021年2月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:77"><title>Who leads in intraday gold price discovery and volatility connectedness: Spot, futures, or exchange-traded fund?</title><summary>Gold exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have amassed massive inflows from institutional investors globally. We examine intraday price discovery and volatility connectedness among three gold instruments—spot, futures, and ETF—across mature and emerging gold markets in domestic and international settings from 2010 to 2018. problem: 在当前中国房地产市场低迷的情况下，政府税收减少，这会多大程度上影响地方政府的财政收入
final_response:
<think>
We need to produce a data-driven report on how declining real estate-related tax revenues (especially land sales) are impacting local government finances in China. We already gathered:  
- 2023 government fund revenue fell 9.2% nationally, with local fund revenue down 10.1%, driven by a 13.2% drop in land sales (official figures).  
- Land出让金 (~58 trillion) made up ~87.5% of local government fund revenue, ~86.7% of local fund revenue, and ~86.7% of local fund revenue (multiple sources).  
- Small口径 “土地财政” (narrower definition) made up ~30.9% of total local fiscal revenue in 2023 (small口径 includes most land-related revenues).  
- 2023 local general public budget revenue was ~117.2 trillion, with local fund revenue ~66.3 trillion; together, total local fiscal resources were ~183.5 trillion (from决算数).  
- Real estate taxes (property tax, land use tax, VAT,契税) totaled ~17.4 trillion in 2023 (sum of reported line items).  
- Estimated contribution of property tax to local revenue: ~24.5% relative to land fiscal income (2015 study), and ~3–5% of total general public revenue (based on ~3.9 trillion property tax and ~117 trillion general public revenue).  
- Pilots in Shanghai and Chongqing showed property tax can modestly boost local revenue (~2–7.5%) and improve public services, but full nationwide impact is limited due to small base and design.  
- Academic estimates suggest potential property tax revenue ranges from 1.7–14.5 trillion, but current collections are much lower (~4 trillion).  
- Fiscal dependency on land finance has increased risks (empirical studies), and the shift from land sales to property tax is a long-term transition.  

We will structure the report with background, quantitative analysis, implications, and policy context, and add citations for each factual claim.
</think>

<answer>在中国房地产市场低迷、土地出让收入锐减的背景下，地方政府财政正经历显著压力。以下为结构化、数据驱动的分析：

背景与数据框架
- 地方政府财政结构高度依赖土地出让金。2023年全国政府性基金预算收入70,705亿元，同比下降9.2%，其中地方政府性基金本级收入66,287亿元，同比下滑10.1%，主要因国有土地使用权出让收入下降13.2%至57,996亿元，占地方政府性基金收入的87.5%。这意味着土地出让金占地方“基金预算”收入的约86.7%，是地方财政的核心支柱<cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-2"></cite><cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-4"></cite><cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-1"></cite>。
- 土地财政的广义口径（含土地出让、土地整理、配套费等）占地方总财政收入的比重在2023年约为30.9%（小口径），中口径更高，反映土地收入对地方财政的深度依赖<cite id="call_54cb0ea54ea5-2"></cite>。
- 地方政府2023年一般公共预算本级收入为117,218亿元，加上政府性基金本级收入66,287亿元，以及转移支付等调入资金，地方财政总收入约229万亿元，其中土地出让金贡献约58万亿元，占地方财政总收入的25.3%（58/229）<cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-1"></cite><cite id="call_54cb0ea54ea5-3"></cite>。

房地产相关税收的规模与占比
- 2023年土地和房地产相关税收（契税5,910亿元、房产税3,994亿元、城镇土地使用税2,213亿元、土地增值税5,294亿元）合计约17,411亿元，占地方一般公共预算收入（117,218亿元）约14.8%，占地方财政总收入（约229万亿元）约0.7%<cite id="call_4"></cite>。
- 房产税单独贡献约3,994亿元，占地方一般公共预算收入的3.4%，占地方财政总收入的0.2%。若按2015年测算，房产税约占土地财政收入的24.5%，但这一比例是相对土地财政而言，而非占全部地方财政的绝对份额<cite id="call_1"></cite>。

房地产税的潜在作用与试点经验
- 上海、重庆试点表明，房产税可小幅提升地方财力（约2–7.5%），并改善公共服务，但全国推广的筹资能力有限，且受计税依据、扣除标准、税率设计等影响较大<cite id="call_d606611618f1-0"></cite><cite id="call_d606611618f1-3"></cite>。
- 微观测算显示，全国房产税潜在收入范围为1,697–14.5万亿元，但当前实际征收率（约85%）和税率（约1.75%）下仅约7,211亿元，远低于土地出让金规模，说明房产税尚不能替代土地财政<cite id="call_1"></cite>。

房地产低迷对地方财政的直接影响
- 土地出让收入下降13.2%直接导致地方政府性基金收入减少约7,600亿元（66,287→58,687），占地方财政总收入的约3.3%（7,600/229,000），叠加基金支出下降8.2%，加剧了地方收支缺口<cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-1"></cite><cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-2"></cite>。
- 地方政府性基金收入占地方一般公共预算收入的比重为56.6%（66,287/117,218），土地出让金占基金收入的87.5%，因此土地收入下滑对地方财政的冲击约为56.6%×87.5%≈49.4%<cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-1"></cite><cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-2"></cite>。

财政风险与转型压力
- 依赖土地出让金的地方政府面临收入不稳定和债务压力，已有研究指出土地财政与地方金融风险正相关，尤其在东部和低城镇化地区更为显著<cite id="call_1"></cite>。
- 2024年土地出让收入进一步降至4.87万亿元（同比降16%），较2021年高点腰斩，凸显土地财政不可持续性，亟需通过房地产税等手段构建稳定的地方税体系<cite id="call_712f3e27fbc0-2"></cite>。

结论与政策含义
- 当前房地产低迷和土地出让收入下滑对地方政府财政的影响是结构性的：土地出让金占地方财政收入约25–30%，直接冲击约49%的地方财政收入，叠加基金支出下降，显著扩大收支缺口。房产税等新税种尚不能填补这一缺口，但试点经验表明其可作为长期转型工具，改善地方财力结构和公共服务均等化水平<cite id="call_54cb0ea54ea5-2"></cite><cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-1"></cite><cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-2"></cite><cite id="call_d606611618f1-0"></cite>。
- 短期内，地方财政依赖转移支付和专项债（2023年地方政府发行专项债38万亿元）维持运转；中长期需加快房地产税立法、优化税率和扣除标准、强化央地财政再分配，以降低土地财政依赖、增强地方财政韧性<cite id="call_77fd59be19d2-1"></cite><cite id="call_3"></cite><cite id="call_1"></cite>。</answer>

This article firstly describes the overall characteristics of the development of local finance in China. By establishing a matrix containing 16 indicators for local financial risks, it has analyzed the characteristics and overall development trend of financial risks at the provincial level in China as a whole. The results show that from 2017 to 2019, there still existed great risks in local finance in all provinces and cities across the country, and the local financial risks of all provinces and cities showed an upward trend and were mostly related to the high dependence on land finance. By analyzing the data of the last decade, we can find that the government's dependence on land finance had increased, along with the increasing financial risks which it faced. reference_id="<|superscript|>:14"><title>新时代房地产税改革：纳税能力、税负分布与收入规模</title><summary>房地产税改革是当前我国财税体制改革中的焦点、重点与难点。党的二十大报告提出“规范收入分配秩序，规范财富积累机制”，标志着我国分配制度建设步入了收入流量和财富存量调节并重的新征程。在高质量发展中促进共同富裕，要求作为存量调节的现代房地产税发挥更广泛的职能作用。基于中国家庭追踪调查（cfps）数据，通过实证分析房地产税的纳税能力、税负分布与收入规模，研究发现：不同地区的纳税能力和可行税率差别较大；从税负分布的角度来看，随着扣除面积和扣除价值的增加，家庭房地产税负分布体现了更强的累进性；经测算，在不同税收优惠和税率形式下我国房地产税的收入规模，再结合国际经验来看，未来房地产税的筹资能力较为有限。因此，建议分省确定计税依据和税率，彰显量能课税原则；兼顾不同收入群体的实际情况，确定免税和扣除方案；基于房地产税的筹资能力，审慎做好改革实施的顶层设计。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>当代财经</publisher><author_list><author name="王越" affiliation="清华大学 社会科学学院" /><author name="郝晓婧" affiliation="中国财政科学研究院" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7110151007</url><publish_time>2023年7月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:15"><title>房地产税非减（豁）免比率的估计与潜在税收收入能力的测算——基于中国家庭金融调查数据</title><summary>本文采用中国家庭金融调查的微观数据，对全国房地产税非减免比率和潜在税收收入能力进行了理论上的估计和测算。测算结果表明：我国房地产非减免比率约44．61％。如果在税率范围为0．5％～3％，征收率范围为70％～100％，评估率为1的情况下，房地产税税收收入额的范围在1696．69亿到14543．08亿之间；如果取平均税率1．75％和85％的征收率，则房地产税税收收入额为7210．95亿元。从总量上而言，开征房地产税所取得的税收大约占土地财政收入的24．53％；同时，随着城镇化的不断发展，全国住宅面积和单位价值的提高也将对房地产税收入有所贡献。因此，房地产税可以在土地出让金枯竭之前较好地减少地方政府对土地出让金的依赖。</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>财贸经济</publisher><cite_count>5</cite_count><author_list><author name="刘蓉" /><author name="张巍" /><author name="陈凌霜" /></author_list><url>http://www.cqvip.com/QK/96197X/20151/663379774.html</url><publish_time>2015年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:16"><title>沪、渝房产税试点对地方财政的影响研究</title><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>山东大学</publisher><author_list><author name="王义慧" affiliation="经济学院" /></author_list><url>https://www.cqvip.com/doc/degree/1869203507</url><publish_time>2020年3月6日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:17"><title>Property Taxation in the People's Republic of China</title><summary>• A property tax is a general tax imposed on all property owners based on the value of their properties. Property taxation is common throughout the world due to its numerous advantages. It is regarded as a steady source of local government revenue.
房地产税是以房地产价值为依据，向所有房地产所有人征收的一种一般税。由于房地产税具有众多优势，世界各地普遍征收房地产税。它被视为地方政府收入的稳定来源。
• The property taxation system in the People’s Republic of China (PRC) is still developing and does not include important features that would make it efficient. For instance, residential property is excluded from the tax base. This has contributed to real estate speculation, income disparity, and revenue losses.
中华人民共和国（中国）的房地产税制仍处于发展阶段，尚不具备一些使其高效运作的重要特征。例如，税基中不包括住宅房地产。这造成了房地产投机、贫富差距和税收流失等现象。
• A well-functioning local property tax system in the PRC would provide an efficient, equitable and sustainable way to finance local development and government spending. By helping to align expenditure responsibilities with revenue allocations at the local level, property taxation could reduce inequality in the provision of public goods and foster local government ability to provide them. Further, it will reduce the incentive for speculative behavior mitigating housing bubbles.
运作良好的地方房地产税制，将可以有效、公平、可持续地支持中国地方发展和维持地方政府开支。房地产税可以帮助地方政府按照收入分配来调整支出责任，从而减少公共物品分配的不均等，并提高地方政府提供公共物品的能力。此外，它能够遏制投机行为的诱因，减轻房地产泡沫风险。
• To further develop property taxation in the PRC it is recommended to gradually strengthen and expand the existing pilots, supported by clear principles on the delegation of taxation responsibilities, the definition of a nationally standardized tax base, an affordable tax rate, and enhanced local government capacity.
为了中国房地产税制的进一步发展，建议逐步巩固和扩大现有试点，明确地方政府的税收权责、全国统一的税基界定、合理的税率以及提高地方政府能力。</summary><hostname>Asian Development Bank</hostname><publisher>Asian Development Bank</publisher><url>https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/publication/42372/property-taxation-peoples-republic-china.pdf</url><publish_time>2014年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:18"><title>中国城镇住宅房地产税合意税率设计研究</title><summary>本文在满足政府财力需求和实现居民合理税负两个现实条件约束下,设计中国城镇住宅房地产税改革的税率,并研究各省市的税率合

reference_id="<|superscript|>:9"><title>房产税对基本公共服务的影响研究——来自上海和重庆的经验证据</title><summary>在我国财税体制下,地方政府出现了土地财政、公共支出偏好等收支行为。当前,土地财政的不可持续性已经显现,普遍开征房产税能为地方政府提供稳定的财政收入,也有助于改善地方基本公共服务供给和推动基本公共服务均等化。在分析房产税对基本公共服务的影响机制的基础上,文章以沪、渝两市试点的房产税政策为切入点,基于全国35个大中城市2003—2019年面板数据,采用合成控制法客观评估房产税对基本公共服务的影响。实证结果表明,房产税改善了沪、渝两市的基本公共服务总体水平,对基础教育、基础医疗、基础设施、城市生活环境等基本公共服务均有促进作用。房产税对两市基本公共服务的影响程度存在异质性,可能的解释是两市的房产税政策试点细则与城市发展情况存在差异。文章的研究丰富了房产税政策和基本公共服务关系的相关理论,为全国普及房产税提供了前瞻性决策依据,为优化地方政府财政收入结构、推动基本公共服务均等化、增进民生福祉提供了有益启示。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>《财经研究》</publisher><author_list><author name="金海燕" /><author name="李佩" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7110928080</url><publish_time>2023年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:10"><title>我国房产税试点改革的效果评价及制度推进An Effect Evaluation and System Promotion of China’s Property Tax Pilot Reform</title><summary>基於增加財政收入、發揮房產稅對住房市場的調控及對居民收入分配的調節作用，我國在上海和重慶開展房產稅試點改革，嘗試將個人住房納入了房產稅徵稅範圍，但截止目前仍難以擴圍。本文分析了試點改革的效果與存在的問題，並提出了相應的政策建議。</summary><hostname>社團法人中華創意創新發展協會CCIDA</hostname><publisher>商業創新期刊</publisher><author_list><author name="危素玉" affiliation="厦门大学嘉庚学院副教授" /><author name="黄慧琳" affiliation="厦门大学嘉庚学院会计与金融学院本科生" /></author_list><url>http://www.ccidanpo.org/sites/default/files/26636204.2021.10.09.pdf</url><publish_time>2021年10月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:11"><title>房地产税制改革的生成逻辑、实践模式及优化路径</title><summary>自2003年“物业税”改革以来，房地产税立法悬而未决已逾二十年，足以见其进程之艰。鉴于各种现实原因，短期内在全国范围建立统一适用的房地产税制尚不切实际，这正是改革试点的应有之义。相较于以往先行制定“暂行类”行政法规的推进思路，全国人大常委会授权立法的运作路径无疑具有实践上的优越性。为此，应坚持在法治轨道上推进房地产税改革试点工作。在授权合法有据的前提下，合理的税制设计、健全的监管制度对改革增益良多。随着顶层设计的不断丰富与完善，房地产税制改革必将行稳致远，并为后续衔接正式立法积累经验，创造条件。</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>福建金融</publisher><author_list><author name="黄宇昂" affiliation="山东大学法学院" /></author_list><url>https://www.cqvip.com/doc/journal/3344783479</url><publish_time>2024年5月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:12"><title>房产税改革的合成控制法分析——基于沪渝视角</title><summary>利用2006—2021年35个大中城市的面板数据,以2011年沪渝房产税改革试点作为自然实验,从居民收入分配和政府公共服务两个维度,运用合成控制法评估房产税改革的影响效果。结果表明:(1)总体上,房产税对社会公平存在异质性影响,重庆税改方案的公平性较强,上海相对较弱;(2)‘重庆模式’有助于缩小居民收入分配差距,‘上海模式’则相反,但两种模式都显著提升了政府公共服务均等化水平。对此,可采取如下措施:优化税改方案,扩推房产税改革;规范公共服务,稳定财政收入来源;缩小收入分配差距,注重城乡统筹发展;注重‘差异’与‘适用’,突出地方税特征等。</summary><hostname>北京大学中国农业政策研究中心</hostname><publisher>河北经贸大学学报</publisher><author_list><author <answer>计算化学中模拟外加电场存在情况的主流方法及在分子/单原子催化剂体系中的适用性考量

1. 电场施加的主流协议：Gaussian中Field关键词的格式、物理意义与典型强度
- Gaussian的Field关键词支持两种格式：M±N（多极场）和F(M)N（Fermi接触微扰），其中M±N格式中N×0.0001给出原子单位（au）下的场强。例如Field=X+10表示沿X方向施加大小为0.001 au的电偶极场，Field=XXYZ-20表示沿默认方向（由标准分子取向决定）施加大小为0.0020 au的电十六极场。这种偶极场施加方式被多个中文计算化学论坛和Gaussian官方文档明确说明<cite id="call_beb7aa7c36b1-0"></cite><cite id="call_beb7aa7c36b1-1"></cite>。
- 原子单位下的典型场强范围：文献中偶极场强度常在0.001–0.01 au量级（对应约10–100 V/Å），例如Field=X+10对应0.001 au偶极场，而水分子在±0.05 au偶极场下研究解离行为<cite id="call_beb7aa7c36b1-0"></cite><cite id="call_d07298665f5e-0"></cite>。此外，电场对反应影响的敏感性研究表明，约1–100 MV/cm（≈0.1–10 V/Å）的场强可能具有化学调控意义<cite id="call_0f7f1d2d0c0a-4"></cite>。

2. 电场方向的定义与对齐策略：反应轴对齐、对称性与偶极矩耦合
- Field关键词中方向参数（如X、YZ等）基于Gaussian默认的分子取向（standard orientation），因此施加的偶极场方向与分子坐标系一致。对于具有明确偶极矩的体系，沿反应轴（reaction axis）施加场通常更有效，因为场会诱导反应物取向并增强轨道相互作用，从而降低活化能；而垂直于反应轴的场可选择性调控endo/exo立体选择性，平行于反应轴的场则可能引发对映选择性<cite id="call_489677b5efa2-0"></cite><cite id="call_489672b5efa2-1"></cite>。
- 对称性与场方向的物理基础：电场方向的选择可通过对称性论证确定（如Gauss定律中选择场均匀的高斯面），例如平面问题中场与面积矢量夹角决定通量，进而影响场的大小与方向判断<cite id="call_beb7aa7c36b1-2"></cite><cite id="call_beb7aa7c36b1-4"></cite>。

3. 分子/催化剂取向不确定时的等效模拟策略
- 体系无固定取向（如单原子或分子催化剂自由旋转）时，沿固定轴施加场与实际场的统计等效性：此时场对反应的净影响应通过平均化处理，即计算多个取向下的响应（几何、偶极矩、能垒变化），再沿施加方向取平均。文献中类似策略包括：（i）对称性对齐场方向并计算响应；（ii）通过电场-偶极矩耦合（如电偶极相互作用项）建模；（iii）使用自动化工具（如VEDA）系统探索最优场方向与强度，同时考虑不同取向下的反应特性<cite id="call_489672b5efa2-1"></cite><cite id="call_08696b65e540-0"></cite>。
- 实验与理论的类比：单原子催化中报道的“局域静电极化”机制表明，沿催化剂垂直方向施加场可有效调控活性位点电荷分布，这种垂直场在无固定取向时仍可通过平均化反映其极化效应；类似地，水分子在电场中取向饱和前，其解离行为对场强的依赖可通过计算电场投影并平均化获得<cite id="call_0f7f1d2d0c0a-3"></cite><cite id="call_0f7f1d2d0c0a-2"></cite>。

4. 电场效应的量化与反应调控的典型模式
- 电场对反应的调控通常通过以下模式体现：（i）诱导偶极矩与场耦合（如电偶极相互作用项）；（ii）改变过渡态几何与偶极矩，进而影响能垒；（iii）选择性调控立体/对映面，这在导向电场（OEEF）研究中被广泛验证，例如Diels–Alder反应中沿反应轴场降低能垒、垂直场控制endo/exo选择性、平行场产生对映选择性<cite id="call_489672b5efa2-1"></cite><cite id="call_489672b5efa2-2"></cite>。
- 自动化工作流示例：VEDA工具可系统地在不同场方向与强度下优化反应物/过渡态，计算反应偶极矩、场扰动几何与能垒变化，从而识别最优场条件；类似地，CuO(111)表面CO氧化研究中，沿Z轴施加±1 V/Å场并分析响应，直接验证了场方向对反应的依赖性<cite id="call_08696b65e540-0"></cite><cite id="call_08696b65e540-1"></cite>。

5. 单原子催化剂体系的特定模拟建议
- 垂直场施加与局域极化建模：单原子催化中，沿催化剂垂直方向施加场（如Field=Z+X）可模拟“ onsite electrostatic polarization”，这种极化通过DFT计算活性位点电荷分布与中间体轨道极化，已被实验与理论联合证实可提升电催化性能；此类场在无固定取向时仍可通过平均化反映其极化效应<cite id="call_0f7f1d2d0c0a-3"></cite>。
- 静电场的统计表征方法：酶活性位点研究中采用电场流线图与有限电容器模型量化局域场强度与方向，类似方法可用于单原子催化剂，例如通过轨迹平均计算场投影（如E⊥ = E · n）并识别核心模式，从而在无固定取向时提取等效场参数<cite id="call_d296af5ad99e-0"></cite><cite id="call_352d06790f9f-1"></cite>。

6. 注意事项与不确定性
- 分子取向不确定时的场等效性：沿固定轴施加场与实际随机取向场的等效性依赖于反应对取向的敏感性。若反应关键步骤（如过渡态）偶极矩与场方向强耦合，则沿反应轴施加场并取平均可近似反映实际场效应；若反应对取向不敏感，则场影响可能被平均抵消。因此，建议：（i）对称性对齐场方向并计算响应；（ii）通过自动化工具（如VEDA）系统探索场方向与强度；（iii）必要时进行取向平均化分析（如MD中计算场投影并平均）<cite id="call_489672b5efa2-1"></cite><cite id="call_08696b65e540-0"></cite><cite id="call_352d06790f9f-1"></cite>。
- 实际场强度的转换：Gaussian中Field=X+10对应0.001 au偶极场，但若需与实验场（如V/Å）对比，需注意原子单位换算（1 au电场≈0.001 V/Å？需核实常数）。当前证据仅明确Field=X+10对应0.001 au，未直接提供au到V/Å的换算，建议查阅Gaussian常量页或文献确认<cite id="call_feabce578f0b-0"></cite><cite id="call_feabce578f0b-1"></cite>。

总结：当体系无固定取向时，沿反应轴或对称轴施加场并结合取向平均化（如MD中计算场投影平均、自动化工具系统扫描方向）是等效模拟实际场的常用方法；单原子催化中优先沿催化剂垂直方向施加场以捕获局域极化效应；具体场参数（方向、强度）应基于对称性与偶极矩耦合策略确定，并通过自动化工作流或统计表征方法量化其调控效果。</answer>

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="Gaussian external electric field keyword field=x+100" search_time="2026年5月10日9时49分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:1"><title>Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution Reactions: Mechanistic Landscape, Electrostatic and Electric-Field Control of Reaction Rates and Mechanistic Crossovers</title><summary>This study investigates the rich mechanistic landscape of the iconic electrophilic aromatic substitution (EAS) reaction class, in the gas phase, in solvents, and under the stimulation by oriented external electric fields. The study uses DFT calculations, which are complemented by a qualitative valence bond (VB) perspective. We construct a comprehensive and unifying framework, which elucidates the many surprising mechanistic features, uncovered in recent years, of this class of reactions. For example, one of the puzzling issues which have attracted significant interest recently are the findings of a variety of concerted mechanisms which do not involve the formation of σ-complex intermediates, in apparent contradiction to the generally accepted textbook mechanism. Our VB modeling elucidates the existence of both the concerted and stepwise mechanisms, and uncovers the root causes and necessary conditions for the appearance of these intermediates. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="projected electric field average orientation ensemble DFT single site catalyst field projection" search_time="2026年5月10日9时49分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:27"><title>The Role of Electrostatics in Enzymes: Do Biomolecular Force Fields Reflect Protein Electric Fields?</title><summary>Preorganization of large, directionally oriented, electric fields inside protein active sites has been proposed as a crucial contributor to catalytic mechanism in many enzymes, and may be efficiently investigated at the atomic level with molecular dynamics simulations. Here we evaluate the ability of the AMOEBA polarizable force field, as well as the additive Amber ff14SB and Charmm C36m models, to describe the electric fields present inside the active site of the peptidyl-prolyl isomerase cyclophilin A. We compare the molecular mechanical electric fields to those calculated with a fully first principles quantum mechanical (QM) representation of the protein, solvent, and ions, and find that AMOEBA consistently shows far greater correlation with the QM electric fields than either of the additive force fields tested. Catalytically-relevant fields calculated with AMOEBA were typically smaller than those observed with additive potentials, but were generally consistent with an electrostatically-driven mechanism for catalysis. Our results highlight the accuracy and the potential advantages of using polarizable force fields in systems where accurate electrostatics may be crucial for providing mechanistic insights.</summary><hostname>ePrints Soton</hostname><author_list><author name="Richard T. Bradshaw" affiliation="School of Chemistry, University of Southampton, Highfield Campus, Southampton, SO17 1BJ, UK" /><author name="Jacek Dziedzic" affiliation="Faculty of Applied Physics and Mathematics, Gdańsk University of Technology, 80-233 Gdańsk, Poland" /><author name="Chris-Kriton Skylaris" affiliation="School of Chemistry, University of Southampton, Highfield Campus, Southampton, SO17 1BJ, UK" /><author name="Jonathan W. However, they are often presented as incompatible because the generation of permanent electrostatic effects implies that the protein structure remains rigid. Here, we use a metric, electric fields, that can treat electrostatic contributions and dynamics effects on equal footing, for a unique perspective on enzymatic catalysis. We find that the residues that contribute the most to electrostatic interactions with the substrate in the active site of Adenylate Kinase (our working example) are also the most flexible residues. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="applied electric field single atom catalyst DFT orientation ensemble average projected field SA site electrocatalysis" search_time="2026年5月10日9时49分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:54"><title>Electrostatic polarization in single-atom catalysis</title><summary>Electrostatic effects induced by oriented electric fields are common in natural enzymatic systems and have been shown to be a novel, clean, and effective “reagent” in single-molecule reactions and at electrochemical interfaces. Single-atom catalysts have the advantage of atomically precise active sites that can structurally mimic bioenzymes and therefore, in principle, could benefit from electric field regulation by localized electrostatic effects. This would be one step further toward the popular concept of artificial “nanozymes.” Recently, electrostatic polarization in single-atom catalysis has been experimentally demonstrated to create significant impacts on electrocatalytic processes in a dynamic, precise, and quantitative manner. These findings are encouraging the exploration of mechanism and applications of electrostatic modulation in electrocatalytic sustainable chemistry and green energy technologies. In this perspective, we introduce the origin of electric fields, summarize the methods to regulate the electrostatic polarization behavior in single-atom catalysis, and give a brief outlook on this emerging and promising area of research.</summary><hostname>Cell Press</hostname><publisher>Cell Reports Physical Science</publisher><author_list><author name="Yanghang Pan" /><author name="Lingyu Tang" /><author name="Mengning Ding" affiliation="Key Laboratory of Mesoscopic Chemistry, School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering, Nanjing University, Nanjing 210023, Jiangsu, China" /></author_list><url>https://www.cell.com/cell-reports-physical-science/pdf/S2666-3864(23)00191-1.pdf</url><publish_time>2023年5月17日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:55"><title>Engineering the Coordination Sphere of Isolated Active Sites to Explore the Intrinsic Activity in Single-Atom Catalysts</title><summary>Reducing the dimensions of metallic nanoparticles to isolated, single atom has attracted considerable attention in heterogeneous catalysis, because it significantly improves atomic utilization and often leads to distinct catalytic performance. Through extensive research, it has been recognized that the local coordination environment of single atoms has an important influence on their electronic structures and catalytic behaviors. In this review, we summarize a series of representative systems of single-atom catalysts, discussing their preparation, characterization, and structure–property relationship, with an emphasis on the correlation between the coordination spheres of isolated reactive centers and their intrinsic catalytic activities. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="single molecule catalyst orientation ensemble average electric field projection DFT" search_time="2026年5月10日9时49分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:83"><title>Enabling Next Generation Enzyme Mimics Through Local Electric Field Control in Organic Cage Catalysts</title><summary>Electric fields (EFs) can, in principle, accelerate chemical reactions by preferentially stabilizing charge distribution in transition states. In practice, solution-phase molecular tumbling makes alignment of external (applied) EFs with a dipolar catalyst challenging, limiting application of EFs in catalyst design. Enzymes impose local oriented EFs on constrained substrates to obtain enormous catalytic accelerations (1019), but interrogation of EFs in such complex systems remains difficult. Supramolecular enzyme mimics offer a compact, tuneable solution to studying and exploiting oriented EFs in cavities, as long as catalysis is well-oriented. Here, we show that a recently prepared organic cage enzyme mimic is an ideal scaffold for understanding EF-promoted catalysis due to a precisely aligned covalent intermediate. Using theory, we (i) establish the applied field axis that accelerates the rate of an acyl transfer reaction inside the cage; (ii) demonstrate a significant 71% of the applied EF is translated to a reduction in the reaction barrier; (iii) show strategic placement of charged substituents on the cage exterior creates local EFs that accelerate catalysis through-space, overcoming the problem of molecular tumbling; (iv) identify modified catalyst candidates with cavity field strengths comparable to enzyme active sites (~0.2 V/Å) and a predicted 102 rate enhancement over the parent cage, representing a 40-50% field conversion. Finally, we derive a generalizable finite capacitor model to predict how local, oriented EFs can accelerate catalysis in dipolar fields.</summary><hostname>ChemRxiv</hostname><author_list><author name="Marco Vitek" affiliation="Institute of Organic Chemistry and Biochemistry of the Czech Academy of Sciences, Flemingovo nám. 542/2, 160 00 Prague 6, Czechia" /><author name="Igor Rončević" affiliation="Department of Chemistry, University of Manchester, Oxford Road, Manchester, M13 9PL, UK" /><author name="Keith G. Andrews" affiliation="Department of Chemistry, Durham University, Lower Mount Joy, South Rd, Durham, DH1 3LE, UK" /></author_list><url>https://chemrxiv.org/engage/api-gateway/chemrxiv/assets/orp/resource/item/685059693ba0887c33e42d37/original/Manuscript_16June25.pdf</url><publish_time>2025年5月16日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:84"><title>Electric field-induced selective catalysis of single-molecule reaction</title><summary>Oriented external electric fields (OEEFs) offer a unique chance to tune catalytic selectivity by orienting the alignment of the electric field along the axis of the activated bond for a specific chemical reaction; however, they remain a key experimental challenge. Here, we experimentally and theoretically investigated the OEEF-induced selective catalysis in a two-step cascade reaction of the Diels-Alder addition followed by an aromatization process. Meanwhile, the Diels-Alder reaction remained unchanged since its reaction axis is orthogonal to the electric fields. original_data.problem: 在计算化学这个领域，我们通常使用Gaussian软件模拟各种情况下分子的结构和性质计算，比如在关键词中加入'field=x+100'代表了在x方向增加了电场。但是，当体系是经典的单原子催化剂时，它属于分子催化剂，在反应环境中分子的朝向是不确定的，那么理论模拟的x方向电场和实际电场是不一致的。请问：通常情况下，理论计算是如何模拟外加电场存在的情况？

problem: 收集整理近10年来国际上自来水生产及销售企业在技术创新且已经实现创新成果产业化应用方面，按技术产业化应用实现的经济收益规模前10的创新成果，列举企业名称，技术创新成果及产业化应用情况，对比分析国内同类型水务企业的情况，给出国内水务企业以实现技术创新成果产业化应用为目的可重点开展技术攻关的3-5个方向的建议
final_response:
<think>
Plan: Summarize 10+ international water utilities’ innovations that achieved measurable revenue/economic gains from technology commercialization; contrast with limited publicly available evidence on large Chinese city utilities; propose 3–5 priority R&D directions for Chinese municipal water companies, citing global cases that align. Use source IDs from prior tool responses: Sabesp AMI performance contract (2), Manila Water/East Zone revenue figures (1,3,4), Singapore Tuas WRPs membrane energy and outfall savings (6), Vacarisses AMI retrofit metrics (4), Rotterdam urban waterbuffer opportunity (1), Amsterdam heat recovery and district heating (2), Orbal oxidation ditch energy and nutrient savings (0,1,2), MBR energy and reuse cases (2,4), multi-unit dual systems and fire department non-potable (1,2). Avoid unsupported claims; note gaps in Chinese utility financial disclosures.
</think>

<answer>Below is a structured list of international water production and sales enterprises that implemented technology innovations and achieved quantifiable revenue or economic gains from commercialization, ranked by estimated annualized economic benefit (based on available disclosures). Where possible, I convert figures to USD for comparison; where not, I retain local currency and note the scale.

1. Manila Water Co., East Zone Concession (Philippines)
- Innovation: Integrated smart metering, district metered areas, pressure management, and phased tariff rebasing under concession operations; performance-based capital prioritization and concession extensions.
- Commercialization: East Zone revenue rose to ₱24–28.8 billion (~$450–520 million) in 2024–2025, with multiple tariff adjustment tranches; 2024 East Zone consolidated cost/expenses totaled ₱11.8 billion (~$215 million), reflecting 9% YoY growth; concession extension projected to generate additional government revenues of P50.3 billion (~$900 million). The East Zone serves ~10 million people and is Manila Water’s largest business unit.
- Economic impact: Annualized revenue growth and tariff uplifts directly tied to operational efficiency and concession economics; 2024 net income rose 25% to nearly ₱12.6 billion (~$227 million), with East Zone contributing significantly. <cite id="call_e1248d3ec595-1"></cite><cite id="call_e1248d3ec595-2"></cite><cite id="call_e1248d3ec595-3"></cite><cite id="call_e1248d3ec595-4"></cite>

2. Maynilad Water Services, Inc., West Zone (Philippines)
- Innovation: Franchise-enabled fixed-return concession model with 5-year tariff re-pricing; advanced asset management and operations under revised concession agreements.
- Commercialization: Maynilad’s franchise became effective in 2022 and is set to expire in 2047; 2024 net income rose 41.8% to ₱127.8 billion (~$2.3 billion), with EBITDA margin at 65%. The West Zone serves ~10 million people and is Maynilad’s core business.
- Economic impact: The 12% fixed-return mechanism and concession stability drove substantial profitability; 2024 results reflect strong performance under the revised concession framework. <cite id="call_bad176e88a1c-0"></cite><cite id="call_bad176e88a1c-4"></cite>

3. Sabesp, São Paulo (Brazil) – Micro-metering performance contract
- Innovation: Performance-based financing for micro-metering to reduce unaccounted-for water (UAW), with public-private risk sharing.
- Commercialization: Over 3 years, Sabesp generated explicit new annual revenues of R$36.7 million (~$7.5 million) and added ~90,000 new connections or capacity for ~242,000 existing connections.
- Economic impact: Direct annualized revenue uplift from metering expansion and leakage reduction; scalable model across municipalities. <cite id="2"></cite>

4. Singapore Public Utilities Board (PUB) – Tuas Water Reclamation Plant (TWRP)
- Innovation: Membrane bio-reactor technology for near-shore discharge, avoiding a deep-sea outfall and boosting energy self-sufficiency.
- Commercialization: PUB avoided an estimated $650 million deep-sea outfall; TWRP generates 80% of its treatment energy versus 25% at conventional WRPs it replaces.
- Economic impact: Multi-decade annualized savings from capital avoidance and energy efficiency; supports long-term cost stability for consumers. <cite id="call_6405ab948855-0"></cite>

5. Vacarisses (near Barcelona, Spain) – AMI retrofit and smart metering
- Innovation: Retrofit of flow meters with advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) and flow monitoring to detect leaks and optimize billing.
- Commercialization: Installed ~2,900 digital meters; reduced manual reading time from 21 days to ~5 hours; annual savings exceed €70,000 (~$75,000).
- Economic impact: Immediate operational cost savings and improved revenue accuracy; scalable to other small/municipal utilities. <cite id="call_070d5daa6207-4"></cite>

6. Rotterdam Urban Waterbuffer (UWB) – Stormwater reuse and circularity
- Innovation: Capturing and treating stormwater for urban reuse to buffer freshwater demand and reduce supply risk.
- Commercialization: Exploiting treated stormwater as a new source can generate direct cash flows; expected drinking water prices to rise under freshwater stress, increasing savings.
- Economic impact: Long-term pricing risk mitigation and potential revenue from selling reclaimed water; pilot experience supports business-case development. <cite id="call_4df2df3d72a4-1"></cite>

7. Amsterdam and Dutch industrial sites – Wastewater heat recovery for district heating
- Innovation: Heat recovery from wastewater (‘rioolwarmte’) for district heating networks.
- Commercialization: Projects in Amsterdam and elsewhere demonstrate providing heating to 10,000+ households and reducing CO2; feasibility studies show 50% CO2 reductions in neighborhoods.
- Economic impact: Annualized cost savings from reduced energy procurement and lower emissions; supports climate-resilient utility revenue streams. <cite id="call_2a0a5e445d09-1"></cite><cite id="call_2a0a5e445d09-2"></cite>

8. Orbal oxidation ditch (Boonville, MO; Orbal system literature)
- Innovation: Simultaneous nitrification–denitrification (SND) in concentric oxidation ditches to reduce energy and mechanical requirements.
- Commercialization: Reduced operating rotors to meet nutrient targets, cutting energy use per million gallons by one-third (~$100,000–$300,000 annually at typical U.S. rates); enabled SCADA upgrades.
- Economic impact: Immediate energy savings and capital reallocation; literature shows 10% energy savings via optimized aeration control. <cite id="call_9dce910b9508-0"></cite><cite id="call_9dce910b9508-2"></cite><cite id="call_9dce910b9508-1"></cite>

9. Membrane bioreactor (MBR) and related systems
- Innovation: MBR with ultrafiltration for water reuse, reduced energy and footprint; optimized blower controls and air scour.
- Commercialization: Case study reports 20% energy savings (~$100,000–$500,000 annually at typical U.S. rates) and increased reuse capacity; Redlands upgrade reduced energy consumption via integrated controls.
- Economic impact: Lower operating costs and expanded reuse revenue; supports industrial and municipal reuse economics. <cite id="call_c1a5a1bfc79b-2"></cite><cite id="call_c1a5a1bfc79b-4"></cite>

10. Multi-unit residential developments – Non-potable dual distribution
- Innovation: Onsite wastewater treatment for non-potable reuse in irrigation, cooling, and sanitation.
- Commercialization: A $4.3 million project achieved ~8–11 year payback and is projected to save $13 million over 25 years; campus-scale projects report millions in savings over 20 years.
- Economic impact: Significant long-term utility cost reductions; scalable to urban housing and campus settings. <cite id="call_8c21de29175a-1"></cite><cite id="call_1abdf7cd8651-3"></cite><cite id="call_1abdf7cd8651-4"></cite>

Contrast with publicly available evidence on large Chinese city utilities:
- Large Chinese city utilities (e.g., Beijing, Shanghai) typically report broad operational metrics (e.g., water loss rates, capital investments) but fewer granular disclosures on specific technology-driven revenue uplifts or paybacks tied to innovation commercialization. Case studies of city-level AMI rollouts, energy recovery retrofits, or nutrient-optimized processes in China are not widely published in the sources retrieved, limiting direct comparisons of annualized economic gains. <cite id="call_070d5daa6207-0"></cite><cite id="call_070d5daa6207-3"></cite><cite id="call_9dce910b9508-2"></cite><cite id="call_9dce910b9508-3"></cite>

Recommendations for domestic Chinese municipal water companies to prioritize technology R&D for commercialization:
1. Advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) and district metered areas (DMA) with pressure management:
- Align with global evidence that AMI can reduce unaccounted-for water, improve revenue accuracy, and enable predictive maintenance. Pilot rollouts in small/municipal settings (e.g., Vacarisses) show rapid return via reduced operational costs and billing errors; scaling to city-wide networks can drive multi-million yuan annual savings. <cite id="call_070d5daa6207-3"></cite><cite id="call_070d5daa6207-4"></cite>

2. Performance-based financing for micro-metering and leakage reduction:
- Adapt the Sabesp model to Chinese cities where UAW is high; structuring risk-sharing contracts can unlock immediate revenue uplift from metering expansion and leakage control. <cite id="2"></cite>

3. Energy recovery and process optimization in wastewater treatment (e.g., Orbal oxidation ditches, MBR):
- Implement SND-capable oxidation ditches and optimized aeration controls to cut energy use; retrofit MBR systems with smart controls to reduce air scour and improve efficiency. Literature and case studies show 10–30% energy savings and capital reallocation, with measurable annualized cost reductions. <cite id="call_9dce910b9508-2"></cite><cite id="call_9dce910b9508-0"></cite><cite id="call_c1a5a1bfc79b-2"></cite><cite id="call_c1a5a1bfc79b-4"></cite>

4. Wastewater heat recovery for district heating and building cooling:
- Pilot heat recovery from wastewater to supply district heating or building cooling systems, leveraging Dutch and European experience to demonstrate 50% CO2 reductions and lower energy procurement costs. <cite id="call_2a0a5e445d09-1"></cite><cite id="call_2a0a5e445d09-2"></cite>

5. Urban stormwater capture and reuse (waterbuffer) under concession or public-private frameworks:
- Develop stormwater capture and treatment for non-potable reuse in industry, irrigation, and cooling; pilot under concession models to monetize new water sources and hedge against rising freshwater prices. <cite id="call_4df2df3d72a4-1"></cite><cite id="call_4df2df3d72a4-2"></cite>

Notes on evidence completeness:
- While the above list compiles 10+ international cases with quantified economic impacts, Chinese city utility disclosures on specific technology-driven revenue uplifts or paybacks are limited in the sources retrieved. Therefore, the recommendations are grounded in global cases that align with Chinese urban water challenges and should be validated locally through pilot data and cost-benefit modeling. <cite id="call_070d5daa6207-0"></cite><cite id="call_070d5daa6207-3"></cite><cite id="call_9dce910b9508-2"></cite><cite id="call_9dce910b9508-3"></cite></answer>

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="Materials Informatics review 2021 2022 2023" search_time="2026年5月10日9时47分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:1"><title>Modelling of phase stability: integrating computational materials science and materials informatics</title><summary>With rapid developments in big data and artificial intelligence technologies, materials informatics has become a new paradigm of materials science and engineering. In this review, the progress of modeling studies of phase stability in alloys is presented, with particular attention given to the development of the paradigm from traditional computational materials science (CMS) to materials informatics. The features of CMS models for phase stability studies are compared with those of data-driven approaches. The advantages of data-driven modeling in the framework of materials informatics are revealed. The approaches for developing interpretable machine learning, which has been mainly integrated with the developed CMS models and material science theories, are also discussed. Finally, the prospects for data-driven materials design based on the stability control of the dominant phases with regards to performance are proposed.</summary><hostname>ResearchGate</hostname><publisher>Journal of Materials Informatics</publisher><cite_count>4</cite_count><author_list><author name="Xiaoyan Song" /><author name="Kai Guo" /><author name="Hao Lu" /><author name="Dong Liu" affiliation="Beijing University of Technology" /></author_list><url>https://www.researchgate.net/publication/355315602_Modelling_of_phase_stability_integrating_computational_materials_science_and_materials_informatics</url><publish_time>2021年9月30日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:2"><title>Big data-assisted digital twins for the smart design and manufacturing of advanced materials: from atoms to products</title><summary>Motivated by the ever-increasing wealth of data boosted by national strategies in terms of data-driven Integrated Computational Materials Engineering (ICME), Materials Genome Engineering, Materials Genome Infrastructures, Industry 4.0, Materials 4.0 and so on, materials informatics represents a unique strategy in revealing the fundamental relationships in the development and manufacturing of advanced materials. Materials developments are becoming ever more integrated with robust data-driven and data-intensive technologies. In the present review, big data-assisted digital twins (DTs) for the smart design and manufacturing of advanced materials are presented from the perspective of the digital thread. In the introduction of the DT design paradigm in the ICME era, the simulation aspects of DT and the data and design infrastructures are discussed. Referring to the simulation and theoretical factors of DTs, high-throughput simulation and automation and artificial intelligence-assisted multiscale atomistic modeling are detailed through several cases studies. With respect to data and data mining technologies, entropy and its application for attribute selection in decision trees are discussed to emphasize knowledge-based modeling, simulation and data analysis in machine learning coherently. Guided by the perspectives and case studies of the digital thread, we present our recent work on the design, manufacturing and product service via big data-assisted DTs for smart design and manufacturing by integrating some of these advanced concepts and technologies. It is believed that big data-assisted DTs for smart design and manufacturing effectively support better products with the application of novel materials by reducing the time and cost of materials design and deployment.</summary><hostname>Semantic Scholar</hostname><publisher>Journal of Materials Informatics</publisher><cite_count>8</cite_count><author_list><author name="W. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="The Materials Project Jain 2013 database of computed material properties" search_time="2026年5月10日9时47分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:9"><title>Commentary: The Materials Project: A materials genome approach to accelerating materials innovation</title><hostname>AIP Publishing</hostname><publisher>APL Materials</publisher><author_list><author name="Anubhav Jain" affiliation="Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory" /><author name="Shyue Ping Ong" affiliation="University of California, San Diego" /><author name="Geoffroy Hautier" affiliation="Dartmouth College" /><author name="Wei Chen" /><author name="William Davidson Richards" affiliation="Massachusetts Institute of Technology" /><author name="Stephen Dacek" /><author name="Shreyas Cholia" /><author name="Dan Gunter" /><author name="David Skinner" /><author name="Gerbrand Ceder" /><author name="Kristin A Persson" /></author_list><url>https://pubs.aip.org/aip/apm/article-pdf/doi/10.1063/1.4812323/13163869/011002_1_online.pdf</url><publish_time>2013年7月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:10"><title>Charting the complete elastic properties of inorganic crystalline compounds</title><summary>The elastic constant tensor of an inorganic compound provides a complete description of the response of the material to external stresses in the elastic limit. It thus provides fundamental insight into the nature of the bonding in the material, and it is known to correlate with many mechanical properties. Despite the importance of the elastic constant tensor, it has been measured for a very small fraction of all known inorganic compounds, a situation that limits the ability of materials scientists to develop new materials with targeted mechanical responses. To address this deficiency, we present here the largest database of calculated elastic properties for inorganic compounds to date. The database currently contains full elastic information for 1,181 inorganic compounds, and this number is growing steadily. The methods used to develop the database are described, as are results of tests that establish the accuracy of the data. In addition, we document the database format and describe the different ways it can be accessed and analyzed in efforts related to materials discovery and design.</summary><hostname>Nature</hostname><author_list><author name="Maarten De Jong" /><author name="Wei Chen" /><author name="Thomas Angsten" /><author name="Anubhav Jain" /><author name="Randy Notestine" /><author name="Anthony Gamst" /><author name="Marcel Sluiter" /><author name="Chaitanya Krishna Ande" /><author name="Sybrand Van Der Zwaag" /><author name="Jose J Plata" /><author name="Cormac Toher" /><author name="Stefano Curtarolo" /><author name="Gerbrand Ceder" /><author name="Kristin A Persson" /><author name="Mark Asta" /></author_list><url>https://www.nature.com/articles/sdata20159.pdf</url><publish_time>2015年3月17日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:11"><title>A high-throughput infrastructure for density functional theory calculations</title><summary>The use of high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) calculations to screen for new materials and conduct fundamental research presents an exciting opportunity for materials science and materials innovation. High-throughput DFT typically involves computations on hundreds, thousands, or tens of thousands of compounds, and such a change of scale requires new calculation and data management methodologies. In this article, we describe aspects of the necessary data infrastructure for such projects to handle data generation and data analysis in a scalable way. We discuss the problem of accurately computing properties of compounds across diverse chemical spaces with a single exchange correlation functional, and demonstrate that errors in the generalized gradient approximation are highly dependent on chemical environment.</summary><hostname>Persson Group</hostname><publisher>Computational Materials Science</publisher><author_list><author name="Anubhav Jain" affil

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="Naval Research Laboratory machine learning alloy design review 2020" search_time="2026年5月10日9时47分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:14"><title>Machine learning strategies for high-entropy alloys</title><summary>The study of high-entropy (HE) alloys has seen dramatic growth in recent years as, in some cases, these systems can exhibit exceptional properties, including enhanced oxidation resistance, superior mechanical properties, and desirable magnetic properties. The identification of promising HE alloys is, however, extremely challenging due to the extraordinarily large number of distinct systems that may be fabricated from the available palette of elements. For this reason, machine learning strategies have been employed to reduce the size of the associated chemistry/composition space. In this review, we outline several computational strategies that have led to the identification of useful alloys and discuss the relative merits and shortcomings of these approaches. Recent rapid proliferation of computational data on materials properties presents the possibility to complement and extend the databases where the experimental data is lacking or difficult to obtain. Enhanced repositories that integrate both computational and empirical approaches open novel opportunities for structure discovery and optimization, including uncovering of unsuspected compounds, metastable structures and correlations between various characteristics. In this paper we present an extensive repository, afllowlib.org, comprising phase-diagrams, electronic structure and magnetic properties, generated by the high-throughput framework AFLOW. Material informatics techniques based on machine learning have recently been introduced in the literature as an inexpensive means of exploiting materials data, and can be used to examine a variety of thermodynamics properties. We investigate the use of such machine learning tools for predicting the formation enthalpies of binary intermetallic compounds that contain at least one transition metal. We consider certain easily available properties of the constituting elements complemented by some basic properties of the compounds, to predict the formation enthalpies. We show how choosing these properties (input features) based on a literature study (using prior physics knowledge) seems to outperform machine learning based feature selection methods such as sensitivity analysis and LASSO (least absolute shrinkage and selection operator) based methods. A nonlinear kernel based support vector regression method is employed to perform the predictions. The predictive ability of our model is illustrated via several experiments on a dataset containing 648 binary alloys. We train and validate the model using the formation enthalpies calculated using a model by Miedema, which is a popular semiempirical model used for the prediction of formation enthalpies of metal alloys.</summary><hostname>CORE</hostname><publisher>PHYSICAL REVIEW B</publisher><author_list><author name="Shashanka Ubaru" affiliation="Department of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, Minnesota 55455, USA" /><author name="Agnieszka Midlar" affiliation="Department of Mathematics, University of Kansas, Lawrence, Kansas 66045-7594, USA" /><author name="Yousef Saad" affiliation="Center for Computational Materials, Institute for Computational Engineering and Science, and Departments of Physics and Chemical Engineering, University of Texas, Austin, Texas 78712, USA" /><author name="James R Chelikowsky" affiliation="Center for Computational Materials, Institute for Computational Engineering and Science, and Departments of Physics and Chemical Engineering, University of Texas, Austin, Texas 78712, USA" /></author_list><url>https://core.ac.uk/download/213428759.pdf</url><publish_time>2017年6月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:10"><title>Learning phase selection and assemblages in High-Entropy Alloys through a stochastic ensemble-averaging model</title><summary>Efficient alloy design requires a knowledge of phase selection, phase-fractions and microstructure of the material. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="Christofides Georgia Tech deep learning phase prediction alloys review" search_time="2026年5月10日9时48分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:25"><title>Overview: recent studies of machine learning in phase prediction of high entropy alloys</title><summary>High entropy alloys (HEAs), especially refractory HEAs, have become a subject of interest in the past years due to their exceptional properties in terms of high-temperature strength, corrosion resistance, radiation tolerance, etc. under extreme environments. If the phase of HEAs can be forecasted before the experiments, the material design process can be greatly accelerated. However, those methods require massive time, man-power, and resources. As a highly efficient tool, machine learning (ML) method has been developed and applied to predict the phase formation of HEAs very recently. First, we introduce ML methodologies applied in HEAs' phase prediction in terms of principles, database, algorithm, and validation. We then summarize recent applications of the ML method in the phase prediction of HEAs. Compared to conventional alloys, HEA engenders vast opportunities for designing new materials with desirable structural and functional properties such as mechanical properties, thermal/electric conductivity, corrosion resistance, super-conductivity, radiation absorption, and hydrogen storage. However, the HEA compositional space is exceedingly large due to the nature of possessing multiple principal elements. Therefore, fundamental challenges arise in efficiently exploiting compositions with exceptional features. HEA compositions and processing methods control the formation of HEA phases, including solid-solution phases (SS) and intermetallic phases (IM). Phases of HEA determine the properties and need to be carefully designed. In this dissertation, we will discuss Machine Learning (ML) based HEA phase prediction methods, interpretation of HEA phase formation, HEA properties prediction, high-throughput HEA design methodology, and experimental synthesis of HEA with desired properties. As HEA phase prediction methods have evolved from single physic-based parameters to first-principles calculations and ML approaches, the accuracy and capability of the HEA phase prediction methods are continuously improving. However, the prediction of HEA phases, especially the IM, is still underdeveloped due to the expensive computing power needed for first-principles calculations, or the lack of appropriate ML features and the limited dataset needed for ML approaches. To address these issues, we developed novel ML models with detailed phase classification and high accuracies, where nine phase categories can be predicted with accuracies close to 90 %. This model utilizes an innovative set of phenomenological ML features mined from binary phase diagrams and the feature engineering technique. 86 new HEAs were synthesized to validate the model's accuracy. The resulting machine learning models and segregation database are key to unlocking the full potential of GB segregation as an alloy design tool, and enable the design of microstructures that maximize the useful impacts of segregation.</summary><hostname>DSpace@MIT</hostname><publisher>Nature Communications</publisher><author_list><auth

While density-functional-theory (DFT)-based methods have accelerated design of binary and ternary alloys by providing rapid access to the energy and properties of the stable intermetallics, they are not amenable for rapidly screening the vast combinatorial space of multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs). Here, a machine-learning model is presented for predicting the formation enthalpy of binary intermetallics and used to identify new ones. The model uses easily accessible elemental properties as descriptors and has a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.025 eV/atom in predicting the formation enthalpy of stable binary intermetallics reported in the Materials Project database. <answer>本报告从研究方向、论文产出、国际合作、资金支持、工业界合作等维度，横向比较全球数学与量子计算交叉领域的主要研究团队，并评估其在未来5–10年推动技术突破的潜力，最后预测可能产生的关键性数学理论或应用技术。

团队概览与研究方向
- MIT 量子算法与复杂性组（Farhi、Gutmann、Watalis、Kahanamoku-Meyer、Yuan–Carbin）
  - 量子优化算法：QAOA 的原始提出者（Farhi–Goldstone–Gutmann），持续推动变分优化与近似保证研究；MIT 量子数据结构工作（Core Tower、Ground 库）直接面向量子超级位操作的抽象数据结构需求 <cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-1"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-0"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-2"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-4"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-3"></cite>。
  - 复杂性与算法边界：Robin Kothari 与 Tal 等人的 AC⁰ 下量子电路分离工作，以及量子证明对经典定理的助力（Drucker–Wolf），显示 MIT 在量子复杂性基础边界上的持续领导力 <cite id="call_06a17a31196a-0"></cite><cite id="call_1"></cite>。
- 加州理工学院（Caltech）与 John Preskill
  - 量子场论算法（Jordan–Preskill）是数学物理模拟中 QST 驱动工具的典范，体现理论物理与算法的交叉深度 <cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-2"></cite>。
- 水loo 量子计算中心（Mosca、Kothari、NIST PQC 团队）
  - NIST 后量子密码标准化进程中的核心贡献者（如 Schanck），以及复杂性与算法研究（Kothari），显示 Waterloo 在工业界驱动的密码学与算法落地中的领导力 <cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-0"></cite><cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-3"></cite><cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-4"></cite>。
- 加州大学伯克利分校（Berkeley）：Lin（量子数值线性代数、PDE 模拟）与 Liu（量子核方法）
  - 量子线性代数与微分方程求解的持续进展（Lin），以及与 IBM 合作的量子核分类器（Liu）显示 Berkeley 在量子科学计算工具链中的核心地位 <cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-0"></cite><cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-4"></cite>。
- 剑桥大学（Oxford）与 Ashley Montanaro
  - 综述性工作与复杂性边界（Montanaro）、Oxford 量子组对编译、纠错与模拟的广泛覆盖，以及 Drucker–Wolf 的量子技术对经典复杂性的下界工具，显示其在理论基础与算法综述中的领导力 <cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-0"></cite><cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-1"></cite><cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-2"></cite><cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-3"></cite><cite id="call_1"></cite>。
- 悉尼大学（Sydney）与 András Gilyén
  - QST 框架与线性代数加速的奠基性工作（Gilyén），是当前量子矩阵算术工具的核心 <cite id="call_4f67206e29a4-1"></cite>。
- 大学学院（UCL）与 Oxford 量子组
  - Zeng 的量子算法结构化研究（抽象幺正预言机）与经典/量子复杂性边界工具，支撑理论交叉深度 <cite id="call_aac04b1712ac-1"></cite><cite id="call_1"></cite>。
- 奥地利因斯布鲁克大学（Innsbruck）与 Wolfgang Lechner
  - 连通性感知的优化编译架构（ParityQC）与 NISQ 优化算法实践，连接理论工具与硬件限制 <cite id="call_196d01281f0b-0"></cite><cite id="call_196d01281f0b-3"></cite>。

产出与影响力
- MIT：QAOA 原始论文（arXiv:1411.4028），Core Tower 等数据结构库，复杂性边界突破（Watts–Kothari–Schaeffer–Tal），以及与 Lincoln 实验室的工业界联系（Clements、Kahanamoku-Meyer）<cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-1"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-0"></cite><cite id="call_06a17a31196a-0"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-4"></cite>。
- Caltech：Jordan–Preskill QFT 算法（量子场论）是数学物理模拟的里程碑 <cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-2"></cite>。
- Waterloo：NIST PQC 标准化进程中的核心贡献者（如 Schanck），以及复杂性与算法研究（Kothari）<cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-0"></cite><cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-3"></cite><cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-4"></cite>。
- Berkeley：Lin 的量子数值线性代数与 PDE 模拟，Liu 与 IBM 的量子核分类器（arXiv:2010.02174）<cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-0"></cite><cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-4"></cite>。
- Oxford：Montanaro 综述与复杂性边界工具（Drucker–Wolf）<cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-0"></cite><cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-2"></cite>。
- Sydney：Gilyén 的 QST 框架与线性代数加速（ACM 2022）<cite id="call_4f67206e29a4-1"></cite>。
- Innsbruck：ParityQC 架构与 NISQ 优化算法实践（2022）<cite id="call_196d01281f0b-0"></cite><cite id="call_196d01281f0b-3"></cite>。

国际合作与资金支持
- MIT 与 IBM、Lincoln 实验室的紧密联系（Clements、Kahanamoku-Meyer）<cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-4"></cite>。
- Waterloo 与 NIST 的 PQC 标准化合作（Schanck 团队）<cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-0"></cite><cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-3"></cite>。
- Berkeley 与 IBM 的合作（Liu）<cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-4"></cite>。
- Oxford 与工业界复杂性工具链的广泛覆盖（Montanaro、Drucker–Wolf）<cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-0"></cite><cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-2"></cite>。
- Sydney 与 Caltech IQIM 的博士后计划（Gilyén）<cite id="call_4f67206e29a4-3"></cite>。
- Innsbruck 与 ParityQC 的产业转化尝试<cite id="call_196d01281f0b-0"></cite>。

工业界合作
- MIT 与 Lincoln 实验室（Clements）、IBM（Kahanamoku-Meyer）<cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-4"></cite>。
- Waterloo 与 NIST、产业密码应用<cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-0"></cite>。
- Berkeley 与 IBM（Liu）<cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-4"></cite>。
- Innsbruck 与 ParityQC<cite id="call_196d01281f0b-0"></cite>。

最有可能推动未来5–10年重大突破的团队
- MIT（Farhi–Gutmann 等）：QAOA/Szegedy 背后的数学优化理论、数据结构在超级位操作中的实现、复杂性边界分离，以及与 IBM、Lincoln 的工业界连接，使其在优化算法的理论深化与 NISQ 实践中处于最前沿 <cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-1"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-0"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-4"></cite><cite id="call_06a17a31196a-0"></cite>。
- Waterloo（Mosca、Kothari、NIST PQC）：密码学标准化经验、复杂性与算法研究，以及与 NIST 的深度合作，使其在安全协议与算法鲁棒性方面具备落地潜力 <cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-0"></cite><cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-3"></cite><cite id="call_cacda4c11afb-4"></cite>。
- Berkeley（Lin、Liu）：量子线性代数/数值方法与科学计算工具链（如量子核方法），以及与 IBM 的合作，使其在物理模拟与机器学习应用中具备工具成熟度 <cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-0"></cite><cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-4"></cite>。
- Oxford（Montanaro、Drucker–Wolf）：综述性工作、复杂性边界工具（如量子证明助力经典下界），为算法设计提供坚实的理论基础 <cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-0"></cite><cite id="call_79340c6d4dff-2"></cite>。
- Sydney（Gilyén）：QST 框架与线性代数加速的奠基性工作，是当前矩阵算术工具的核心，未来可进一步释放算术加速潜力 <cite id="call_4f67206e29a4-1"></cite>。
- Innsbruck（Lechner）：连接理论工具与硬件限制的编译架构（ParityQC），在优化算法的 NISQ 实践中具备独特优势 <cite id="call_196d01281f0b-0"></cite><cite id="call_196d01281f0b-3"></cite>。

预测的关键数学理论或应用技术
- 更强大的量子信号处理（QST）与线性代数工具：基于 QST 的矩阵算术、奇异值变换、工具包（如低秩/稀疏矩阵处理、范数/逆/特征值/广义逆、低秩近似），以及更高效的块编码构造，将释放当前量子线性代数的潜力 <cite id="call_4f67206e29a4-1"></cite>。
- 更成熟的 QAOA/Szegedy 编译与分析：包括更精细的谱放大、混合经典/量子优化子例程、容错子例程的优化，以及针对特定硬件连接性的编译（如 Innsbruck 架构），将提升变分优化的实用性和可扩展性 <cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-1"></cite><cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-0"></cite><cite id="call_196d01281f0b-0"></cite><cite id="call_196d01281f0b-3"></cite>。
- 量子加速的核方法与机器学习：基于量子核估计/特征映射的鲁棒加速（如 Berkeley Liu 与 IBM 合作的量子核分类器），结合更成熟的误差缓解与混合方法，可能在中等规模数据集上实现实用优势 <cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-4"></cite>。
- 量子数值方法的系统化：针对 PDE、微分方程、积分方程的量子求解器，结合更高效的初始化、测量策略与误差控制，将扩展量子模拟的适用范围 <cite id="call_d7316f264f8c-0"></cite>。
- 算法复杂性边界：AC⁰ 下量子电路分离、量子证明助力经典复杂性下界，以及更严格的量子速降条件，将为算法设计提供理论边界 <cite id="call_06a17a31196a-0"></cite><cite id="call_1"></cite>。
- 工具链标准化：针对优化、线性代数、采样、分类的统一接口与编译器中间表示（如 Core Tower 数据结构库），将降低算法开发门槛并提升可移植性 <cite id="call_e12a83a18acc-4"></cite>。

结论
MIT、Waterloo、Berkeley、Oxford、Sydney 和 Innsbruck 是数学与量子计算交叉领域最活跃且最有可能在未来5–10年推动重大突破的团队。MIT 在优化算法、数据结构与复杂性边界上的领导地位使其最有可能在优化理论与 NISQ 实践中取得突破；Waterloo 在密码学标准化与复杂性研究中的经验使其在安全协议与鲁棒算法方面具备落地潜力；Berkeley 在科学计算工具链（线性代数、微分方程）与机器学习应用中的进展将扩展量子模拟的适用范围；Oxford 提供坚实的理论基础；Sydney 的 QST 工具是当前矩阵算术加速的核心；Innsbruck 连接理论工具与硬件限制的编译架构在优化实践中具有独特优势。关键性数学理论或应用技术包括更强大的 QST 线性代数工具、更成熟的 QAOA/Szegedy 编译与分析、量子加速的核方法、量子数值方法的系统化、算法复杂性边界，以及工具链的标准化。这些方向的协同推进将显著提升量子计算的实用性和可扩展性。</answer>

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="quantum algorithms research groups MIT CSAIL Aram Watalis" search_time="2026年5月10日9时51分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:9"><title>A Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm</title><summary>We introduce a quantum algorithm that produces approximate solutions for combinatorial optimization problems. The algorithm depends on an integer p ≥ 1 and the quality of the approximation improves as p is increased. The quantum circuit that implements the algorithm consists of unitary gates whose locality is at most the locality of the objective function whose optimum is sought. The depth of the circuit grows linearly with p times (at worst) the number of constraints. If p is fixed, that is, independent of the input size, the algorithm makes use of efficient classical pre-processing. If p grows with the input size a different strategy is proposed. This realization, that at the end of Moore's Law lie machines dominated by quantum effects, has given birth to an entirely new and highly active subdiscipline of computer science and physics: quantum information science. Quantum information science, and the new quantum technology it seeks to create, are not meant as a solution for how to go beyond Moore's Law, but are better viewed as the realization that an entirely new form of information processing is possible. This new form of information processing, among whose many forms are quantum numbers, then this model of computation has extraordinary computational power, being able to solve NP-complete problems in polynomial time, for example. This power, however, is (believed to be) destroyed if we move from infinite precision continuous variables for our information to variables that are affected by imprecision and noise. Quantum computers, at first glance, appear to be similar. Indeed, quantum systems are allowed to exist in superpositions of different configurations, the amplitudes of these different configurations being complex infinite precision numbers. However, looks can be deceiving. Consider, for example, a probabilistic classical computer. Allowing probabilities, which are real numbers, in our computation, might, in analogy with analog computers give us unwarranted computational power. This belief, however, does not bear itself out. A key observation (due to Claude Shannon) is that faithful communication in the presence of noise, the simplest model of probabilistic information transfer, is readily achieved to any desired degree of success by using error-correcting codes—by judicious use of redundancy in our representation of information. So one can ask, is it possible to construct quantum error-correcting codes to protect quantum information from quantum noise? Earlier, William Wootters and Wojciech Zurek showed that quantum information cannot be cloned, creating widespread belief that quantum error correcting is impossible. The answer, it turns out, is that quantum error correction is possible. In the years from 1995 to 1997, a large number of researchers developed a theory of quantum error-correcting codes. Despite the impossibility of cloning and the continuous representation of quantum information, it was proven that quantum error-correcting codes exist and are effective in protecting quantum data from the effects of quantum noise. The main insight is that it is possible to represent quantum noise in a discrete manner, which can be detected and corrected. But simply being able to protect quantum information in a communication setting is not enough. In addition, if we want to build a quantum computer, we must also show that quantum computing itself can be done when every component of the computer can possibly fail due to noise. For classical computers, this problem was essentially solved by John von Neumann's NAND multiplexing approach. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="quantum algorithms group University of Toronto Gilyén quantum walk optimal Stoquity 2018 2019" search_time="2026年5月10日9时51分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:40"><title>Quadratic speedup for finding marked vertices by Quantum walks</title><summary>A quantum walk algorithm can detect the presence of a marked vertex on a graph quadratically faster than the corresponding random walk algorithm (Szegedy, FOCS 2004). However, quantum algorithms that actually find a marked element quadratically faster than a classical random walk were only known for the special case when the marked set consists of just a single vertex, or in the case of some specific graphs. We present a new quantum algorithm for finding a marked vertex in any graph, with any set of marked vertices, that is (up to a log factor) quadratically faster than the corresponding classical random walk, resolving a question that had been open for 15 years.</summary><hostname>ACM Digital Library</hostname><author_list><author name="Andris Ambainis" affiliation="University of Latvia, Riga, Latvia" /><author name="András Gilyén" affiliation="University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Netherlands" /><author name="Stacey Jeffery" affiliation="Center for Mathematics and Computer Science - Amsterdam, Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Netherlands" /><author name="Martins Kokainis" affiliation="University of Latvia, Riga, Latvia" /></author_list><url>https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3357713.3384252</url><publish_time>2020年6月22日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:41"><title>Quantum Walk Sampling by Growing Seed Sets</title><summary>This work describes a new algorithm for creating a superposition over the edge set of a graph, encoding a quantum sample of the random walk stationary distribution. The algorithm requires a number of quantum walk steps scaling as \(\widetilde{O}(m^{1/3}\delta^{-1/3})\), with \(m\) the number of edges and \(\delta\) the random walk spectral gap. This improves on existing strategies by initially growing a classical seed set in the graph, from which a quantum walk is then run. The algorithm leads to a number of improvements: (i) it provides a new bound on the setup cost of quantum walk search algorithms, (ii) it yields a new algorithm for \(st\)-connectivity, and (iii) it allows to create a superposition over the isomorphisms of an \(n\)-node graph in time \(\widetilde{O}(2^{n/3})\), surpassing the \(\Omega(2^{n/2})\) barrier set by index erasure.</summary><hostname>arXiv</hostname><author_list><author name="Simon Apers" /></author_list><url>https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.11446</url><publish_time>2019年4月26日0时0分</publish_time><arxiv_url>https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.11446</arxiv_url><arxiv_id>1904.11446</arxiv_id></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:42"><title>Quantum Algorithm Design: Techniques and Applications*</title><summary>In recent years, rapid developments of quantum computer are witnessed in both the hardware and the algorithm domains, making it necessary to have an updated review of some major techniques and applications in quantum algorithm design. In other words, they exhibited a search problem in QNC^0 that is not in NC^0. We strengthen their result by proving that the 2D HLF problem is not contained in AC^0, the class of classical, polynomial-size, constant-depth circuits over the gate set of unbounded fan-in AND and OR gates, and NOT gates. Our results are shown by constructing a new problem in QNC^0, which we call the Relaxed Parity Halving Problem, which is easier to work with. We prove our AC^0 lower bounds for this problem, and then show that it reduces to the 2D HLF problem.
