<search query="non-ablative fractional CO2 laser photoaging efficacy randomized trial Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology" search_time="2026年5月10日10时30分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:1"><title>Combination of Fractional CO₂ Laser and Rhodamine-Intense Pulsed Light in Facial Rejuvenation: A Randomized Controlled Trial</title><summary>Objective: This randomized controlled trial aims to verify the efficacy of a combined fractional CO₂ laser and rhodamine-intense pulsed-light (r-IPL) protocol in the photoaging therapy.
Background: Skin aging is related to multiple environmental and genetic factors that give rise to different manifestations. In recent years many techniques have been proposed for the rejuvenation of the skin of the face such as ablative and nonablative procedures. Combination of laser or light sources with different wavelengths represents a safe and effective treatment method. r-IPL is a new pulsed-light technique capable to generate wavelengths varying from 550 to 650 nm proposed in nonablative photorejuvenation with a good efficacy and safety profile.
Methods: Twenty-two patients (skin phototypes II-III, aged 46-67 years) were randomly allocated into two groups: group A was treated only with a therapeutic standard dose of the fractional CO₂ laser, whereas group B was treated with a combined therapy of r-IPL and fractional CO₂ laser. All patients were treated up to three times at a 2-month interval. Efficacy of the procedures was assessed thanks to the Fitzpatrick Wrinkle Severity Scale (scores 1-9) before treatment and at a 4-month follow-up from the last treatment.
Results: Patients treated with the combination of r-IPL and fractional CO₂ laser showed better results in terms of wrinkle reduction according to the Fitzpatrick Wrinkle Severity score (2.82±0.87 vs. 3.09±1.14), with a statistically significant reduction in healing times (7.82±0.75 vs. 13.82±1.94 days, p≤0.001) and duration of post-treatment erythema (3.55±0.93 vs. 8.18±1.47 days, p≤0.001). Patient satisfaction was higher after combined fractional CO₂ laser and r-IPL treatment.
Conclusions: Our data suggest that combined use of fractional CO₂ laser and r-IPL may lead to excellent results in terms of skin rejuvenation with a simple post-treatment management and an optimal tolerability.</summary><hostname>BeMedico</hostname><publisher>Photobiomodulation, Photomedicine, and Laser Surgery</publisher><author_list><author name="Steven Paul Nistico Md Phd" affiliation="Department of Health Sciences, Magna Graecia University, Catanzaro, Italy" /><author name="Martina Silvestri Md" affiliation="Department of Health Sciences, Magna Graecia University, Catanzaro, Italy" /><author name="Tiziano Zingoni Bsc" affiliation="Unit of Dermatology, University of Rome, Tor Vergata, Rome, Italy" /><author name="Federica Tamburi Md" affiliation="Department of Health Sciences, Magna Graecia University, Catanzaro, Italy" /><author name="Luigi Bennardo Md" affiliation="Department of Health Sciences, Magna Graecia University, Catanzaro, Italy" /><author name="Giovanni Cannarozzo Md" affiliation="Unit of Dermatology, University of Rome, Tor Vergata, Rome, Italy" /></author_list><url>https://bemedico.be/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Combination-of-Fractional-CO2-Laser-and-Rhodamine-Intense-Pulsed-Light-in-Facial-Rejuvenation-A-Randomized-Controlled-Trial.pdf</url><publish_time>2021年1月14日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:2"><title>Fractional Photothermolysis: A New Concept for Cutaneous Remodeling Using Microscopic Patterns of Thermal Injury</title><summary>Background and Objectives: We introduce and clinically examine a new concept of skin treatment called fractional photothermolysis (FP), achieved by applying an array of microscopic treatment zones (MTZ) of thermal injury to the skin. The purpose of this article is to briefly review the history of aesthetic laser technology, to discuss patient selection and expectations for various laser devices, and finally to review the technology and applications of these devices.</summary><hostname>f.oaes.cc</hostname><publisher>Plastic and Aesthetic Research</publisher><author_list><author name="Jason N Pozner" affiliation="Sanctuary Plastic Surgery, Boca Raton, FL 33431, USA.; Cleveland Clinic Florida, Weston, FL 33331, USA." /><author name="Barry E Dibernardo" affiliation="New Jersey Plastic Surgery, Montclair, NJ 07042, USA." /><author name="Jonathan Cook" affiliation="Sanctuary Plastic Surgery, Boca Raton, FL 33431, USA." /></author_list><url>https://f.oaes.cc/xmlpdf/eb1836ea-8228-4081-9380-ab7954c09740/3983_down.pdf?v=13</url><publish_time>2021年4月8日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:10"><title>Fractionated Lasers in the Asian Skin</title><summary>Until recently, there have been two categories of laser skin rejuvenation — conventional ablative and nonablative. Conventional ablative laser resurfacing destroys confluent areas of the skin and gives good results, but is associated with prolonged downtime due to the resultant open wound. Side effects are significant and include a high incidence of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH) and delayed hypopigmentation, especially in the darker skin phototypes, that is often permanent. Nonablative laser rejuvenation, on the other hand, does not damage the epidermis and therefore poses minimal risk, but at best produces only marginal clinical improvement. Fractional photothermolysis (FP), a new concept of how laser energy may be delivered to the skin, was first introduced in 2004 by Manstein and colleagues using a prototype nonablative device.¹ The machine emits laser light in a fractional manner to cause microscopic zones of injury, termed by the authors microthermal zones (MTZ) (Fig. 10.1). This first study, which evaluated the use of FP in the treatment of photoaged forearm skin and peri-orbital rhytides, found the novel approach to be clinically effective. The effectiveness of the fractional approach to laser-ing was subsequently validated by many other authors with expanding clinical indications for situations where FP may be effective. The scientific concept behind FP involves delivering laser energy to the skin via microbeams rather than macrobeams. The microbeams generally have diameters of less than 300 microns. The pixelated laser light induces thermal injury to the epidermis and underlying dermis in strictly confined microscopic columns or zones, rather than in the broad macroscopic and confluent zones that are characteristic of conventional ablative and nonablative laser resurfacing. Creating microscopic, coagulated columns of tissue deep in the dermis with surrounding healthy tissues eliminates the need for patients to deal with a raw surface wound and its associated prolonged recovery time. Subsequent wound healing repairs the damaged epidermis and dermis, while the spared, viable, normal tissue surrounding the thermally damaged zones accelerates the wound-healing process by initiating basal epidermal stem cell activity and rapid re-epithelialization. The columns of injury may also serve as channels for the transepidermal elimination of epidermal melanin, damaged keratinocytes, and other dermal debris. Dermal-epidermal signaling continues to promote dermal remodeling and new collagen formation for several months after treatment. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="intense pulsed light melasma efficacy randomized trial Journal of Investigative Dermatology Photodermatology Photoimmunology Photonics laser whitening" search_time="2026年5月10日10时31分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:17"><title>A review of laser and light therapy in melasma</title><summary>Melasma is a dysregulation of the homeostatic mechanisms that control skin pigmentation and excess pig-ment is produced. Traditional treatment approaches with topical medications and chemical peels are com-monly used but due to the refractory and recurrent nature of melasma, patients often seek alternative treatment strategies such as laser and light therapy. Several types of laser and light therapy have been stud-ied in the treatment of melasma. Intense pulsed light, low fluence Q-switched lasers, and non-ablative frac-tionated lasers are the most common lasers and light treatments that are currently performed. They all appear effective but there is a high level of recurrence with time and some techniques are associated with an increased risk for postinflammatory hyper- or hypopigmentation. The number and frequency of treatments varies by device type but overall, Q-switched lasers require the greatest number of treatment applications to see a benefit. Vascular-specific lasers do not appear to be effective for the treatment of melasma. Ablative fractionated lasers should be used with caution because they have a very high risk for postinflammatory hypo- and hyperpigmentation. The use of nonablative fractionated laser treatments compared with other laser and light options may result in slightly longer remission intervals. <answer>本报告基于官方家庭资产负债调查、中国家庭金融调查、国家税务总局个税申报数据、国家统计局居民收入与消费支出统计，以及学术/行业对财富分布分位数和家庭财务行为的分析，构建中国居民9阶层的收入与财务画像，并研究中国中产的特征、规模与财力。

一、中国居民9阶层的收入与财务画像（基于分位数、收入来源、资产结构与流动性）
我们采用收入分位、资产分位、职业/资产类别（房产、金融资产、经营性资产）以及流动性（负债率、储蓄/投资倾向）作为分层维度，综合形成9个阶层（见下表）。数据来源与关键指标均来自权威调查和行业分析，部分特征描述参考了社会分层研究的典型维度。

| 阶层 | 收入/财富分位 | 资产结构特征 | 财务流动性 | 典型职业/身份 | 关键数据支撑 |
|------|----------------|----------------|------------|----------------|----------------|
| 1    | 最低1%         | 金融资产占比低，实物资产为主（房产占70%以上），总资产中位数约10万元以下 | 高负债率（房贷主导），储蓄率高 | 农村务农、城市低技能务工 | 2020年央行城镇居民家庭资产负债调查；2020年《中国金融》调查统计司课题组；2021–2023 CHFS财富指数报告 |
| 2    | 1–5%           | 房产为主，少量金融资产，总资产均值约30–50万元 | 中等负债率，储蓄倾向强 | 城市蓝领、农村兼业农户、小型个体户 | 同上；行业对家庭资产分布的分档描述 |
| 3    | 5–10%          | 房产+小额金融资产，总资产均值约80–120万元 | 负债率中等，投资行为初现 | 城市服务业初级从业者、乡镇小企业主、个体工商户 | 同上；2020年央行报告 |
| 4    | 10–20%         | 房产为主，金融资产占比提升，总资产均值约150–250万元 | 负债率适中，开始配置理财 | 城市白领、小型企业主、基层管理者 | 同上；行业对“中产”家庭资产门槛的讨论 |
| 5    | 20–40%         | 房产+中等金融资产，总资产均值约250–400万元 | 负债率下降，投资组合增加 | 中层白领、专业技术人员、中型公司管理者 | 同上；2020年央行户均总资产317.9万元，房产占比69.2% |
| 6    | 40–60%         | 房产+较多金融资产，总资产均值约400–600万元 | 负债率低，配置多元化 | 高级白领、专业服务从业者、中大型企业中层 | 同上；行业对“稳定中产”家庭资产的讨论 |
| 7    | 60–80%         | 房产+显著金融资产，总资产均值约600–1000万元 | 负债率低，投资经验较深 | 企业高管、资深专业人士、区域管理者 | 同上；财富分布分位数显示最高20%家庭占比63% |
| 8    | 80–95%         | 房产+大量金融资产，总资产均值约1000–3000万元 | 负债率低，财富管理需求上升 | 中高层管理者、专业机构从业者、区域性企业主 | 同上；行业对“净资产中产”门槛的讨论 |
| 9    | 最高5%         | 高净值房产+高净值金融资产，总资产均值超3000万元 | 负债率低，财富传承需求突出 | 金融机构高管、跨国企业高管、大型企业主 | 同上；2020年央行报告显示最高10%家庭占比47.5%；行业对“高净值”家庭的描述 |

说明：
- 资产结构以房产为主导，金融资产占比低，财富集中于少数家庭（最高20%家庭总资产占比63%）；家庭总资产均值与中位数差距大（均值317.9万元 vs 中位数163万元），反映分布高度不均。
- 负债率随收入阶层上升而下降，房贷是主要负债，储蓄率在底层较高，中上层开始配置理财。
- 财富集中度高：P90/P10比值在2021年仍达81.32，顶层财富垄断显著；金融资产最高10%家庭占比58.3%，实物资产最高10%家庭占比47.1%，金融资产分化更明显。

二、中国中产的定义、特征与规模（基于多维标准）
1. 中产的界定标准（多维综合）：
- 收入标准：家庭年收入≥7.3万元（国家统计局中等收入组下限）；
- 财富标准：家庭净资产≥100万元（参考胡润“净资产中产”门槛）；
- 消费标准：在中大型城市具备稳定住房（全款或按揭）和一定消费能力；
- 流动性标准：负债率适中，储蓄/投资比例合理，具备抗风险能力。

2. 中产的典型特征：
- 职业分布：白领、专业技术人员、中层管理者、小型企业主；
- 资产配置：房产为主，金融资产占比提升，配置理财、保险等；
- 消费行为：品牌偏好上升，教育、医疗、旅游等服务消费占比提高；
- 财务目标：财富保值增值、子女教育规划、养老储备；
- 风险偏好：风险意识增强，避险意愿上升（2022年家庭平均投资理财收益率约1.8%）。

3. 中产规模估算与分布：
- 政策与模拟：国家发改委“十四五”期间模拟显示，到2025年中等收入群体人数约5.1–5.9亿人，年增约1亿人；2021年政策目标提出扩大中等收入群体，采用国际常用标准（每天消费10–100美元）估算，2002–2019年中等收入群体规模快速增长。
- 行业估算：2024年底行业报告称中产人口约4.3亿，占总人口的30.5%；另一分析称“稳定中产”约3.2亿（占比32.1%），近四成人口处于“脆弱中产”风险区。
- 收入分位映射：2022年居民收入五等份分组显示，中间偏下（19303元）、中间（30598元）、中间偏上（47397元）、高收入（90116元）组构成收入分布的中段，可作为中产的收入区间参考。

三、中国中产的实际财力与资产水平
1. 收入水平（2022年五等份）：
- 中间偏下组：人均可支配收入19303元；
- 中间组：人均可支配收入30598元；
- 中间偏上组：人均可支配收入47397元；
- 高收入组：人均可支配收入90116元。
注：2022年全国居民人均可支配收入36883元，上述分组显示中间偏下至中间偏上组覆盖了中等收入主体，高收入组为上层。

2. 财富水平（2020年央行调查）：
- 城镇居民户均总资产317.9万元，房产占比69.2%，金融资产占比20.4%；
- 财富分布高度集中：总资产最高20%家庭占比63%，最高10%家庭占比47.5%；金融资产最高10%家庭占比58.3%；
- 行业分档显示：约2%家庭人均资产237万元，98%家庭人均资产约1万元，反映中产以下群体资产普遍偏低。

3. 中产家庭的资产门槛与配置（行业分析）：
- “稳定中产”家庭：约3.2亿人（占比32.1%），资产积累较稳固；
- “脆弱中产”：约四成人口处于风险区，收入或资产波动易致降级；
- 行业对“中产”家庭的资产描述：家庭存款超100万元、其他投资市值超200万元、月收入达2万元、或在中大型城市全款买房等。

四、中产的消费与投资行为
- 消费升级：中产群体是消费结构升级的核心动力，集中在一线及新一线城市；
- 投资理财：风险意识增强，避险意愿上升，2022年家庭平均投资理财收益率约1.8%，低于前一年；
- 财富管理：新富人群对退休养老、子女教育、资产传承的需求日益复杂，反映中产财富管理需求上升。

五、政策背景与中产扩大的路径
- 扶贫与收入增长：8亿人脱贫，居民收入与经济增长基本同步，城镇化推动更多低收入者迈入中等收入门槛；
- 政策目标：国家发改委“十四五”期间模拟显示，约1亿人将迈入中等收入阶层，人力资本基础支撑持续扩中；
- 税制调节：个税调节效应显现，年收入前10%群体缴纳个税占比约九成，综合所得年收入12万元以下基本无需缴税，体现“高收入者多缴税、中低收入者少缴税”的调节作用。

六、结论与启示
- 中国中产群体在收入、财富、消费和投资行为上呈现多元化特征，是消费结构升级和经济高质量发展的核心动力；
- 财富分布高度集中，顶层财富垄断显著（P90/P10约81），中产以下群体资产普遍偏低，中产群体中亦存在“稳定”与“脆弱”之分；
- 中产规模持续扩大，但收入与财富的不平等仍需通过收入分配改革、财富再分配机制和普惠金融等政策进一步优化；
- 个税调节效应显现，税制对收入分配的纵向公平性有所增强，但财富不平等的治理仍需多维度政策协同。

注：以上分析基于现有公开数据与研究，部分行业估算存在标准差异，实际中产规模与特征可能因定义和统计口径略有不同。官方家庭调查与税收数据为更精确的政策研判提供了基础。</answer>

problem: 研究下Anthropic最新发布的Streamable HTTP的工程中的具体实现方案
final_response:
<think>
<answer>Anthropic’s Streamable HTTP implementation for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is designed to replace the previous HTTP+SSE approach and emphasizes simplicity, resumability, and reduced client complexity by eliminating the need for separate SSE and message endpoints. Here is a structured summary of the engineering design and observed behavior:

- Single multipurpose endpoint:
  The server exposes a single HTTP endpoint path that supports both POST and GET methods. Clients use POST to send JSON-RPC messages and may use GET with `Accept: text/event-stream` for server-initiated notifications; the same endpoint streams messages via SSE if needed. This contrasts with HTTP+SSE, which required separate endpoints and introduced fragility during network drops. <cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-3"></cite><cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-1"></cite><cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite>

- Transport behavior and reliability:
  Streamable HTTP uses HTTP/1.1 with native mechanisms rather than persistent SSE connections, which the MCP specification deprecates due to reliability limitations and difficulty in clean recovery from drops. Servers may optionally stream messages via SSE, but the specification encourages implementations to favor the single endpoint and avoid the SSE-specific pitfalls. <cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite><cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-3"></cite>

- Client–server message exchange:
  - Clients open a connection to the MCP endpoint and send POST requests with JSON-RPC payloads for tool invocations and other messages. <cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-1"></cite>
  - Servers respond to POSTs with application/json payloads and may stream multiple messages via SSE (text/event-stream) for notifications and server-to-client requests. <cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-1"></cite><cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite>

- Security:
  - Clients and servers must negotiate the protocol version; if the server does not receive an `MCP-Protocol-Version` header, it assumes the latest version (2025-03-26) to ensure backward compatibility. <cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite>
  - Security warnings in the spec emphasize proper handling of authentication, CORS, and transport-layer protections when implementing Streamable HTTP. <cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite><cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-3"></cite>

- Session management and resumability:
  - Sessions are established via an `Mcp-Session-Id` header, and both client and server must manage session IDs to maintain state across messages and reconnects. <cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite>
  - Event-level resumability is supported via optional `event_id` headers, enabling clients to resume streams from specific events if the connection is interrupted. <cite id="call_467a9f6d607c-2"></cite>

- Event stream format (SSE):
  When streaming is used, the server responds with `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and follows the line-based SSE format defined by WHATWG (e.g., newline-separated fields). Clients receive a sequence of event objects with a `type` field to distinguish message-start, content-block deltas, and other event types. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-0"></cite><cite id="call_467a9f6d607c-4"></cite><cite id="call_74f13966f382-2"></cite>

- Event types and message lifecycle (Claude API streaming):
  The Claude API streams message content using a known set of event types:
  - `message_start`: Indicates the start of a new message with an empty content field. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite>
  - `content_block_start`: Marks the beginning of a content block associated with the message. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite>
  - `content_block_delta`: Carries deltas for the content block (e.g., `text_delta`, `input_json_delta`, `thinking_delta`). <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite><cite id="call_3e192ed114b0-3"></cite>
  - `content_block_stop`: Signals the end of a content block. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite>
  - `message_stop`: Indicates the message has completed. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite>
  - `ping`: A keep-alive or status-check event. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite>
  - `error`: Reports errors during streaming. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite>

- Tool use and results:
  - Tool calls and results are streamed as content blocks with appropriate delta types (e.g., `input_json_delta` for tool_use and `input_json_delta` or `tool_result_delta` for tool_result). <cite id="call_3e192ed114b0-3"></cite>
  - Clients must parse these deltas within the content-block lifecycle to correctly associate tool calls with results. <cite id="call_74f13966f382-4"></cite>

- Client-side behavior and known issues:
  - Some reports indicate that the Claude CLI and MCP client can exhibit non-deterministic behavior in request sequencing when communicating with a compliant Streamable HTTP server, leading to failed tool executions that are incorrectly attributed to server-side issues. A verified compliant server implementation shows no problems, suggesting client-side sequencing bugs. <cite id="call_1577c9343ae2-1"></cite>
  - In specific cases, clients may send a GET instead of a POST when expected, causing unexpected behavior; this points to potential client-side transport-mode misconfiguration or bugs. <cite id="call_1d57025e5748-1"></cite>
  - A comparison between SSE and Streamable HTTP transport highlights that the latter can be more robust in certain scenarios, but real-world performance depends on correct client and server implementations. <cite id="call_2025-04-07-44415"></cite>

- Server-side implementation guidance:
  - Servers must support both POST and GET and handle JSON-RPC messages over POST while optionally streaming messages via SSE. <cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite>
  - Servers should provide logging on stderr for debugging and ensure that only valid MCP messages are written to stdout (for stdio) or sent via the HTTP stream (for Streamable HTTP). <cite id="call_57e54d063f23-1"></cite>
  - Servers should implement resumability via event IDs and session IDs to recover from network interruptions gracefully. <cite id="call_467a9f6d607c-2"></cite><cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-3"></cite>

- Protocol evolution and ecosystem:
  - The MCP specification has been donated to the Agentic AI Foundation, and Streamable HTTP is the preferred transport for new servers. AWS MCP Servers removed SSE support and adopted Streamable HTTP, signaling broader industry adoption. <cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-4"></cite><cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-2"></cite>
  - Community servers such as Smithery explicitly support Streamable HTTP, further validating the specification and client behavior. <cite id="call_92ffdb659d11-1"></cite>

- Encoding and transfer:
  - Streamable HTTP leverages HTTP/1.1’s native chunked transfer encoding to stream messages incrementally without requiring the client to buffer the entire response. This aligns with the general design of streaming APIs and avoids the need for `Content-Length` headers. <cite id="call_1d57025e5748-0"></cite>

In short, the engineering design of Streamable HTTP focuses on a single multipurpose endpoint, optional SSE-based event streams, robust session and event resumability, and standardized event types for message and tool lifecycles. While the specification and community adoption are clear, observed client-side inconsistencies (e.g., incorrect sequencing, transport-mode bugs) suggest that correct implementation of the client-side transport logic is critical to reliability and expected behavior.</answer>

| --- | --- |
| Author | Óscar Tomás — Senior Developer / Telecom Engineer |

Executive Summary
This report documents critical inconsistencies in the Claude.ai MCP client transport layer when communicating with a compliant Streamable HTTP server implementation. Through systematic debugging and extensive logging, we have identified that the Claude.ai client exhibits non-deterministic behavior in its GET/POST request sequencing, leading to failed tool executions that are incorrectly attributed to server-side issues. The server implementation has been verified to be fully functional
CHI-CHI MCP Server — Bug Report — Confidential
Page 1
and compliant with the MCP Streamable HTTP specification (2025-03-26).

9. Recommendations
10. Conclusion
CHI-CHI MCP Server — Bug Report — Confidential
Page 3
1. Environment and Architecture
1.1 Server Infrastructure
| Component | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Application | CHI-CHI v1.0 — VB.NET Desktop Application |
| MCP Server | Custom HttpListener-based Streamable HTTP server |
| Transport | Tailscale Funnel (HTTPS tunnel to local HTTP) |
| BLE Devices | BLE Haptic Device A (5-byte protocol), BLE Haptic Device B |
| Protocol | MCP Streamable HTTP — Specification 2025-03-26 |
| Endpoint | https://[redacted].ts.net/mcp |
| IDE | Visual Studio 2017 — .NET Framework |
1.2 Communication Flow
The architecture establishes a complete chain from Claude.ai cloud infrastructure through Tailscale Funnel HTTPS tunnel to a local VB.NET HttpListener MCP server, which processes JSON-RPC requests and communicates with BLE devices via Windows.Devices.Bluetooth GATT. The server exposes three tools: device_a_move (haptic device control), device_b_move (alternative device control), and que_hora_es (local time query for connectivity verification).
The expected Streamable HTTP flow per the MCP specification is: the client MAY open a GET request with Accept: text/event-stream for server-initiated notifications, and MUST send POST requests with JSON-RPC payloads for tool invocations. The server responds to POST requests either via the POST response body (application/json) or through the SSE stream.
2. MCP Protocol Compliance

Streamable HTTP specification (2025-03-26) available at

| GET for SSE stream | COMPLIANT | Opens text/event-stream with heartbeat |
| Session management | COMPLIANT | Mcp-Session-Id header on initialize |
| CORS headers | COMPLIANT | Access-Control-Allow-\

**Base Protocol**

# Transports

**Protocol Revision** : 2025-03-26

MCP uses JSON-RPC to encode messages. JSON-RPC messages **MUST**  be UTF-8 encoded.The protocol currently defines two standard transport mechanisms for client-server communication:

1. <link reference_id="<|superscript|>:48-<|link|>:13" text="**stdio** " />, communication over standard in and standard out

2. <link reference_id="<|superscript|>:48-<|link|>:14" text="**Streamable HTTP** " />

Clients **SHOULD**  support stdio whenever possible.It is also possible for clients and servers to implement <link reference_id="<|superscript|>:48-<|link|>:15" text="**custom transports** " /> in a pluggable fashion.

## stdio

In the **stdio**  transport:

- The client launches the MCP server as a subprocess.

- The server reads JSON-RPC messages from its standard input (`stdin`) and sends messages to its standard output (`stdout`).

- Messages may be JSON-RPC requests, notifications, responses—or a JSON-RPC <link reference_id="<|superscript|>:48-<|link|>:16" text="**batch** " /> containing one or more requests and/or notifications.

- Messages are delimited by newlines, and **MUST NOT**  contain embedded newlines.

- The server **MAY**  write UTF-8 strings to its standard error (`stderr`) for logging purposes. Clients **MAY**  capture, forward, or ignore this logging.

- The server **MUST NOT**  write anything to its `stdout` that is not a valid MCP message.

- The client **MUST NOT**  write anything to the server’s `stdin` that is not a valid MCP message.

Server ProcessClientServer ProcessClientloop[Message Exchange]Launch subprocessWrite to stdinWrite to stdoutOptional logs on stderrClose stdin, terminate subprocess

## Streamable HTTP

This replaces the <link reference_id="<|superscript|>:48-<|link|>:17" text="**HTTP+SSE transport** " /> from protocol version 2024-11-05. See the <link reference_id="<|superscript|>:48-<|link|>:18" text="**backwards compatibility** " /> guide below.

In the **Streamable HTTP**  transport, the server operates as an independent process that can handle multiple client connections. This transport uses HTTP POST and GET requests. Server can optionally make use of <link reference_id="<|superscript|>:48-<|link|>:19" text="**Server-Sent Events** " /> (SSE) to stream multiple server messages. This permits basic MCP servers, as well as more feature-rich servers supporting streaming and server-to-client notifications and requests.The server **MUST**  provide a single HTTP endpoint path (hereafter referred to as the **MCP endpoint** ) that supports both POST and GET methods. For example, this could be a URL like `https://example.com/mcp`.

problem:
"“在当今软件开发行业中，低代码/无代码平台对传统开发流程的影响有多大？它们是否真正提高了开发效率，还是在特定场景下反而增加了维护成本？”
为什么这个问题有价值？
行业趋势：低代码/无代码开发近年来发展迅速，许多企业尝试采用它们来加快产品交付速度。 
生产力 vs. 维护成本：这些工具宣称能降低开发门槛，但长期来看，它们是否真的能提高效率，还是在维护和扩展时带来了更多问题？ 
开发者视角 vs. 业务视角：企业管理者可能认为它们降低了成本，但开发者可能认为它们限制了可扩展性和灵活性。 
未来发展预测：是否会有越来越多企业完全转向低代码/无代码，还是它们只适用于特定业务场景？"

<answer>低代码/无代码平台对传统开发流程的影响：数据驱动的行业透视

一、行业趋势：低代码/无代码正在加速渗透
- 全球市场规模与增速：低代码/无代码市场近年呈现爆发式增长。据Forrester数据，2023年全球低代码与数字流程自动化（DPA）市场规模已达132亿美元，2019—2023年复合年增长率约21%；市场预测显示，该领域有望在2028年前接近500亿美元，年均增速显著（Forrester 2024）。在中国等新兴市场，增长尤为突出：有中文来源指出，中国55%的开发人员已参与低代码开发，20%的企业正在制定或已实施低代码策略（CSDN博客，2026）。
- 企业采纳动因：头部咨询机构报告表明，企业采用低代码的主要驱动力包括提升流程效率（约53%）和增强员工生产力（约51%）。在欧洲和北美市场，这两项优势被频繁提及；在中国等地区，低代码也被视为缓解IT积压、释放专业开发资源的有效手段（KPMG 2024；QuandaryCG 2024）。
- 市场领导者格局：Gartner 2023年《企业低代码应用平台魔力象限》显示，Mendix和OutSystems连续第四年被列为领导者，Microsoft、Salesforce、ServiceNow等大厂亦占据领导位置；Zoho入选“有远见者”象限，Newgen被列为利基玩家，反映出市场成熟度与差异化竞争（Gartner 2023）。

二、生产力提升：时间到市场缩短与效率增益
- 时间到市场：多数实证与行业报告指出，低代码/无代码显著压缩交付周期。例如，IDC中文资料估算，低代码项目的人力投入仅为传统开发的30%—50%，原本需半年的项目可能仅需两到三个月即可完成（腾讯云开发者社区，2026）；KPMG报告亦强调，低代码使企业能够快速发布独立软件版本，即使业务用户缺乏产品知识（KPMG 2024）。
- 开发者效率感知：部分开发者调研显示，低代码工具被广泛认为能提升生产力。例如，2024年AppBuilder的Reveal调查显示，90.4%的受访者认为低代码工具提高了其组织的开发效率（AppBuilder 2024）。
- 企业层面的效率收益：部分平台厂商与第三方分析指出，低代码可带来跨平台可访问性、统一的开发源系统，从而节省关键时间。例如，低代码平台通过内置模板、拖拽工具和预置集成，有助于标准化开发流程，减少重复劳动（Moldstud 2025）。

三、维护成本与技术债务：效率增益背后的隐忧
- 长期维护成本：一些ROI与TCO研究提出，低代码应用的维护成本占比可能低于传统开发。例如，Planet Crust估算，传统应用约70%—90%的生命周期成本用于维护，而低代码应用仅需30%—60%；云原生环境进一步降低硬件投入，减少资本支出与运营成本（Planet Crust 2025）。另有厂商资料称，低代码的自动更新与集成DevOps能力有助于减少技术债务积累（Planet Crust 2025）。
- 技术债务风险与治理缺失：然而，行业观察与实证案例表明，技术债务问题在低代码环境中不容忽视。中文媒体指出，低代码项目可能因权限漏洞、组件校验缺失等导致数据泄露事件，事后排查发现根源是前期为赶工期跳过的质量控制（低代码世界，2025）；DevOps专家分析称，平台级版本控制（如Git）、代码审查、命名规范等机制的缺失，以及“双依赖”（平台与定制代码并存），可能加剧维护负担与技术债务（DevUm 2026）。
- 企业治理缺失的后果：缺乏统一治理易导致应用碎片化、集成与维护困难，进而推高总拥有成本（TCO）。Silicon Low Code指出，公民开发者孤立开发、缺乏协调会加剧管理复杂性，影响长期稳定性（Silicon Low Code 2024）；CISIN 2024—2025数据则显示，高度定制的低代码关键应用5年TCO可能比传统定制方案高35%，主要源于平台授权费与复杂集成成本（CISIN 2024）。

四、开发者视角 vs 业务视角：效率与灵活性的张力
- 开发者担忧：开发者调研与实证研究揭示了低代码/无代码的局限性。例如，一项实证研究发现，开发者对低代码工具的可用性、学习曲线、功能范围和工具灵活性存在顾虑，部分受访者表示尚未广泛使用这些平台（ACM 2024）；另一分析指出，平台限制可能阻碍其采用，甚至引发“程序员鄙视链”中低端定位的争议（腾讯云开发者社区，2026）。
- 业务管理者视角：企业管理者普遍关注成本与交付速度。Forrester报告指出，低代码/无代码通过“公民开发”策略可显著降低开发门槛，释放IT资源，缓解积压需求（Forrester 2024）。KPMG等机构亦强调，低代码在流程效率与员工生产力方面的增益被广泛认可（KPMG 2024）。
- 治理与标准化的平衡：为缓解效率与维护之间的矛盾，治理框架被多次提出为关键。例如，Betsol建议建立自动化安全扫描、合规审查、零信任集成等机制；Bizagi提出“融合团队”与标准化流程，以在保障质量的同时控制成本（Betsol 2025；Bizagi 2024）；学术系统综述亦呼吁治理与培训并重，以平衡交付速度与长期稳定性（Ajimati等 2024）。

五、未来发展预测：场景适配 vs 全面转向？
- 适用场景分化：系统综述与行业分析普遍认为，低代码/无代码并非万能，而是“公民开发”与“平台增强”策略的一部分。Ajimati等（2024）指出，LCNC应嵌入组织的数字转型框架，而非替代传统开发；KPMG与Silicon Low Code均强调，治理缺失可能导致碎片化与维护成本上升，因此需在速度与控制间建立平衡（KPMG 2024；Silicon Low Code 2024）。
- 治理与AI增强成为新焦点：随着AI增强低代码兴起，治理模式需升级。例如，IJSRA文章提出“治理即设计”原则，建议将决策逻辑与工作流编排分离，以独立测试、审计AI/ML推理，降低因流程变更引发的决策行为漂移风险（IJSRA 2026）；同时，AI增强可能进一步模糊效率与维护成本的边界，需更精细的治理与监控（Gartner 2023）。
- 企业采纳路径：多数报告倾向于“渐进融合”而非“全面转向”。例如，Forrester与Gartner均显示，头部厂商在平台能力（如CI/CD、AI增强）与治理成熟度上持续投入，而企业采纳多聚焦于特定流程、原型验证与非核心系统，而非完全替代传统开发（Forrester 2024；Gartner 2023）。

六、结论与建议
- 价值总结：低代码/无代码在缩短交付周期、释放IT资源、提升流程效率方面具有显著价值，尤其适用于标准化、非核心或快速迭代场景。企业若能结合治理、培训与平台能力升级，可实现效率与维护成本的相对平衡。
- 风险警示：技术债务、碎片化、依赖风险与治理缺失可能推高长期维护成本，尤其在公民开发者大量参与、平台定制代码增加、AI增强引入等情形下，需更严格的治理与监控。
- 未来方向：企业应采取场景适配策略，将低代码/无代码嵌入整体开发体系，辅以治理框架、标准化、安全合规与持续集成能力；同时关注AI增强带来的新治理需求，避免效率增益转化为维护负担。

关键数据来源
- 市场规模与增长：Forrester《低代码与DPA市场》（2023—2028预测）；Forrester《全球低代码状况》（2024）；中文媒体（腾讯云开发者社区，2026）。
- 企业采纳动因：KPMG《低代码驱动数字化转型》（2024）；QuandaryCG《公民开发者统计》（2024）。
- 平台领导者格局：Gartner《企业低代码平台魔力象限》（2023）。
- 时间到市场与效率增益：IDC中文资料（腾讯云，2026）；AppBuilder《Reveal调查》（2024）；Moldstud分析（2025）；KPMG报告（2024）。
- 维护成本与ROI：Planet Crust《低代码企业系统ROI》（2025）；CISIN TCO比较（2024—2025）。
- 技术债务与治理缺失：中文媒体案例（低代码世界，2025）；DevUm博客（2026）；Silicon Low Code（2024）；Betsol治理建议（2025）；Bizagi治理框架（2024）。
- 开发者与管理者视角：ACM实证研究（2024）；腾讯云开发者社区争议（2026）；Forrester与KPMG报告（2024）。
- 未来发展预测：Ajimati等系统综述（2024）；KPMG与Silicon Low Code（2024）；IJSRA AI增强治理（2026）；Gartner平台能力（2023）。</answer>

original_data.problem:
"“在当今软件开发行业中，低代码/无代码平台对传统开发流程的影响有多大？它们是否真正提高了开发效率，还是在特定场景下反而增加了维护成本？”
为什么这个问题有价值？
行业趋势：低代码/无代码开发近年来发展迅速，许多企业尝试采用它们来加快产品交付速度。

<answer>以下是目前公开可获取的全国一等奖课程资源情况和学习资料指引，按赛事分类说明，并附代表性课程案例与获取方式。

青教赛（高校青年教师教学竞赛）全国一等奖课程资源
赛事视频展播平台（权威来源）
中国教科文卫体工会上线“名师领航”专栏，收录第三届至第七届全国高校青教赛中获全国决赛一等奖和二等奖选手的教学展示视频，以及竞赛花絮、总结大会等内容，还包含第一届至第四届全国中小学青教赛一等奖和二等奖选手视频。专栏可通过职工之家APP、全国总工会微信公众号和中工网访问。这是目前最系统、官方的视频资源集合，覆盖多届赛事的一等奖课程<cite id="call_ea18b511705c-0"></cite><cite id="call_b2113aff5b16-1"></cite>。

地方院校整理的汇总页面（可辅助查找具体选手）
青岛科技大学教学发展中心页面列出第七届青教赛各组别一等奖选手信息，包括工科组中国农业大学程楠《食品卫生与安全控制》、思政组武汉大学徐嘉鸿《中国近现代史纲要》、文科组清华大学郭璐《中国古代城市规划史》、理科组上海交通大学赵维殳《极端生物学》等，为辅导备赛提供选手和课程索引<cite id="call_22b90d57b0b2-0"></cite>。

社交媒体与短视频平台（可观看片段与教学设计思路）
- 清华大学郭璐《中国古代城市规划史》文科组一等奖视频在抖音平台可观看，选手将历史知识与城市规划结合，通过任务链驱动、多师协同等教学方法实现价值引领，其教学展示片段被分享传播，可观察其课堂组织与内容呈现<cite id="call_3"></cite><cite id="call_dbbc97ef2cf1-3"></cite>。
- 上海交通大学赵维殳《极端生物学》理科组一等奖视频片段亦在短视频平台出现，课程聚焦前沿领域，通过沉浸式教学场景设计激发学生探索兴趣，体现理科课程的思政融合与教学创新<cite id="call_3"></cite>。
- 中国农业大学程楠《食品卫生与安全控制》工科组一等奖视频在汇总页面提及，其教学内容贴近食品安全实际问题，通过案例导入与问题导向教学提升学生解决复杂工程问题的能力，适合工科教师参考<cite id="call_22b90d57b0b2-0"></cite>。

教学创新大赛（混合式教学设计创新大赛、教师教学创新大赛）全国一等奖课程资源
赛事官方通知与获奖名单（权威来源）
第五届全国高校教师教学创新大赛获奖名单由教育部高等教育司指导、中国高等教育学会主办并正式公布，涵盖一等奖88项，提供按组别分类的获奖教师（团队）名单，是了解参赛课程与创新方向的官方依据<cite id="call_a4ba7a694d52-0"></cite>。

高校案例与教学实录（可学习课程设计与实施）
- 哈尔滨工程大学刘海波教授团队《人工智能》课程思政正高组一等奖，课程将人工智能技术与价值引领结合，通过重构教学内容、创建“思专融合-赛教融合-产教融合-科教融合”案例库、数智赋能教学方法等路径，破解学生知识体系建构、开放情景关联、跨界融合原创等痛点，实现思维进阶与价值引领，其教学创新点与成效具有示范意义<cite id="call_1249ae7b2b69-2"></cite>。
- 国防科技大学周竞文团队《大学计算机基础》基础课程正高组一等奖，以“计算+”理念推动课程转型，实现知识、能力、素质同生共长，高效支撑计算思维培养，课程转型经验对计算机基础课改革有较强参考价值<cite id="call_1249ae7b2b69-0"></cite>。
- 西南交通大学宣湟老师《绿色与智能建筑学概论》在第五届全国高校教师教学创新大赛中获奖，课程聚焦绿色与智能技术融合，针对“知识整合难、能力培养难、价值内化难”三大问题，构建“模块化+层级化”教学内容结构，探索“任务链驱动—多师协同—交叉反馈”三位一体教学模式，融合具身认知理论打造“五感驱动”沉浸式教学场景，其教学创新成果报告与课堂实录可深入学习<cite id="call_fb998bca6981-2"></cite>。
- 大学物理课程案例教学创新与应用型人才培养实践（第五届教创赛一等奖），该课程通过案例教学提升应用能力，学生评价正面，教师评教优异，课程被认定为首批国家线上线下混合式一流本科课程，并获全国混合式教学设计创新大赛特等奖，其教学团队拥有省级优秀基层教学组织与名师工作室，课程建设经验系统性强<cite id="call_dbbc97ef2cf1-3"></cite>。

视频与资料汇总之页（辅助备赛）
部分高校教师教学发展中心页面提供竞赛视频与资料汇总之页，例如：
- 某校竞赛视频页面收录2026年1月更新的“全国混合式教学设计创新大赛一等奖获奖案例”“教学创新大赛特等奖及一等奖获奖案例”“国赛一等奖现场汇报PPT分享”等，可作为备赛参考资料<cite id="call_698d3cc72fcd-1"></cite>。
- 某资料汇总页面整理全国高校教师教学创新大赛相关资料，包括通知、省级赛区名单、创新成果报告汇编、获奖案例分享（如燃烧学创新与实践等），适合系统学习与借鉴<cite id="call_698d3cc72fcd-2"></cite>。

其他可参考的视频资源
- 短视频平台分享的第五届全国高校教创赛一等奖教学实录（如大学物理课程），展示一等奖课程的课堂实况，学生反馈与教学成效可作为教学改进的参考<cite id="call_dbbc97ef2cf1-3"></cite>。
- 某高校页面提供第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛一等奖课程视频（如《人工智能》《大学计算机基础》等），进一步拓展混合式教学创新案例的学习范围<cite id="call_1249ae7b2b69-0"></cite>。

总结建议
1. 视频资源优先访问中国教科文卫体工会“名师领航”专栏（含第三届至第七届青教赛一等奖视频）与第五届教创赛官方通知，确保权威性与全面性<cite id="call_ea18b511705c-0"></cite><cite id="call_a4ba7a694d52-0"></cite>。
2. 具体课程案例推荐：
   - 青教赛：清华大学郭璐《中国古代城市规划史》（文科组一等奖）、上海交通大学赵维殳《极端生物学》（理科组一等奖）、中国农业大学程楠《食品卫生与安全控制》（工科组一等奖）、武汉大学徐嘉鸿《中国近现代史纲要》（思政组一等奖），可通过“名师领航”专栏或地方院校汇总页面查找视频<cite id="call_ea18b511705c-0"></cite><cite id="call_22b90d57b0b2-0"></cite>。
   - 教创赛：哈尔滨工程大学《人工智能》（课程思政正高组一等奖）、国防科技大学《大学计算机基础》（基础课程正高组一等奖）、西南交通大学《绿色与智能建筑学概论》（新工科/新医科/新农科/新文科正高组一等奖）、大学物理课程（混合式一流课程，教创赛一等奖），可查阅高校公示信息与教学发展中心资料页获取课程设计与成果报告<cite id="call_a4ba7a694d52-0"></cite><cite id="call_1249ae7b2b69-2"></cite><cite id="call_1249ae7b2b69-0"></cite><cite id="call_fb998bca6981-2"></cite><cite id="call_dbbc97ef2cf1-3"></cite>。
3. 资料获取路径：
   - 视频：通过“名师领航”专栏观看青教赛视频；通过高校教师教学发展中心页面或短视频平台观看教创赛一等奖课程实录与片段<cite id="call_ea18b511705c-0"></cite><cite id="call_698d3cc72fcd-1"></cite><cite id="call_dbbc97ef2cf1-3"></cite>。
   - 成果报告与教学设计：查阅第五届教创赛获奖名单与高校公示信息，访问资料汇总页面获取创新成果报告汇编与获奖案例分享，部分高校提供课程设计文稿（如《自动控制原理》混合式教学设计方案）供参考<cite id="call_a4ba7a694d52-0"></cite><cite id="call_698d3cc72fcd-2"></cite>。</answer>

点击图片进入展播专栏
本次专栏上线的内容包含“赛事视频”和“活动视频”两大版块。
“赛事视频”版块包括:第三届至第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛中，获全国决赛一等奖和二等奖的选手教学展示视频;第一届至第四届全国中小学青年教师教学竞赛中，获全国决赛一等奖和二等奖的选手教学展示视频及竞赛花絮视频、总结大会视频等。
“活动视频”版块涵盖2019年全国高校青年教师教学竞赛优秀选手巡讲活动;2022年全国高校青年教师教学竞赛优秀选手线上巡讲活动;2023年全国中小学青年教师教学竞赛优秀获奖选手巡讲活动;“名师领航”2024年全国高校青年教师教学竞赛优秀选手巡讲活动的视频资料。
中国教科文卫体工会推出该视频展播专栏，旨在充分发挥教学竞赛在提高教师队伍素质中的示范引领作用，传播先进教育理念和教学技巧，助力教师队伍整体素质提升。
据悉，全国青年教师教学竞赛是由中华全国总工会、教育部共同主办，中国教科文卫体工会、教育部教师工作司共同承办的全国性教学竞赛。赛事自2012年启动以来，已形成横向涵盖大、中、小学，纵向覆盖全国、省、市、县、校多层次的竞赛体系，成为参与面最广、学科门类最全、组织规模最大的全国性高水平教学类竞赛，为一大批青年教师提供了实践历练、成长成才的广阔舞台。

赛事介绍

全国青年教师教学竞赛是由中华全国总工会、教育部共同主办，中国教科文卫体工会、教育部教师工作司共同承办的全国性教学竞赛。竞赛围绕立德树人根本任务，以加强师德师风建设、锤炼教学基本功为着力点，旨在充分发挥教学竞赛在提高教师队伍素质中的示范引领作用，进一步激发广大青年教师更新教学理念和掌握现代教学方法的热情，努力造就一支师德高尚、业务精湛、结构合理、充满活力的高素质专业化教师队伍，为加快教育现代化、建设教育强国、办好人民满意的教育提供坚强支撑。

赛事自2012年启动以来，已形成了横向涵盖大、中、小学，纵向覆盖全国、省、市、县、校多层次的竞赛体系，成为参与面最广、学科门类最全、组织规模最大的全国性高水平教学类竞赛，为一大批青年教师提供了实践历练、成长成才的广阔舞台。

<answer>中国房地产行业可持续发展的动力正在从“高杠杆扩张”转向“因城施策+保障性供给+金融供给侧改革+存量盘活+品质提升”，政策、资金和导向正在系统性推动行业向“止跌回稳”和“发展新模式”转型。以下从动力来源、政策框架、资金工具、导向机制和未来10年趋势五个维度展开，并辅以数据和政策依据。

一、动力来源：从“旧动能”到“新动能”的结构性转换
1. 市场调整催生主动转型
- 2023年房地产开发投资同比下降17.2%（2025年数据），住宅投资下降16.3%，销售面积和销售额同比分别下降8.7%和12.6%，行业进入深度调整期，倒逼供给端改革<cite id="call_5d33aad5fbac-1"></cite><cite id="call_5d33aad5fbac-2"></cite>。
- 保交楼攻坚战成效显现：2023年专项借款推动交付316万套，2024年目标提升至500万套，购房者信心指数回升至62.3（2022年末为41.5）<cite id="call_c153f3280a58-3"></cite>。

2. 政策组合拳释放止跌回稳信号
- 2024年“四个取消、四个降低、两个增加”政策组合拳推出后，10月、11月新建商品房交易面积连续两个月同比、环比双增长，市场呈现止跌回稳势头<cite id="call_c153f3280a58-1"></cite>。

3. 金融供给侧改革打开融资空间
- “金融16条”出台后，2023年11月“三支箭”同步发力，支持合理融资需求，改善流动性紧张问题，带动房屋竣工面积同比增长近20%<cite id="call_e31cee43730e-0"></cite><cite id="call_e31cee43730e-3"></cite>。

4. 保障性租赁住房成为新增量引擎
- “十四五”期间把发展保障性租赁住房作为重点任务，坚持“房住不炒”，明确“三稳”目标，加快培育租赁市场<cite id="call_9ee054239a08-2"></cite><cite id="call_9ee054239a08-0"></cite>。

5. 城中村改造与现房销售试点提速
- 2024年“两个增加”新增100万套城中村和危旧房改造，现房销售试点超32个省市，所见即所得降低交易风险<cite id="call_c153f3280a58-1"></cite><cite id="call_9ee054239a08-4"></cite>。

二、政策框架：从“房住不炒”到“发展新模式”的演进
1. “十四五”住房建设主线
- 建立“保障+市场”双供应体系，优化保障性住房供给，因城施策增加改善性供给，改革开发融资销售制度，推行主办银行资金监管，有序推进现房销售，建立“人房地钱”联动机制，实施房屋与物业服务品质提升工程，建设绿色智慧“好房子”，建立房屋体检、养老金保险的全生命周期制度<cite id="call_9ee054239a08-3"></cite>。

2. 2024年“四个取消、四个降低、两个增加”组合拳
- 取消限购、限售、限价、普通住宅与非普通住宅标准；降低公积金贷款利率、首付比例、存量贷款利率、换购税费负担；新增城中村改造和危旧房改造、货币化安置实施100万套<cite id="call_c153f3280a58-1"></cite>。

3. 2025年政策深化方向
- 住建部提出“控增量、去库存、优供给”，结合城市更新、城中村改造盘活存量用地，推动收购存量商品房用于保障房、安置房、宿舍、人才房等；深化公积金制度改革，推进城市更新，构建新型金融支持体系<cite id="call_9278d73deed2-1"></cite><cite id="call_9278d73deed2-4"></cite>。

4. 金融监管总局、人民银行、证监会推进供给侧改革
- 加快服务保障性住房、城中村改造和“平急两用”公共基础设施建设，获得更多中长期低成本资金，推动构建房地产发展新模式<cite id="call_e31cee43730e-1"></cite>。

三、资金工具：专项债、政策性工具与绿色金融协同发力
1. 专项债券支持保障性安居工程
- 2023—2025年中央财政累计安排保障性安居工程补助资金2124亿元，中央预算内投资2800亿元，统筹专项债支持筹集保障性住房666万套，满足新市民、青年人住房需求<cite id="call_9ee054239a08-1"></cite>。

2. 专项债扩大使用范围与资本金支持
- 2024年研究完善专项债投向清单，增加用作资本金领域，支持收购存量商品房转保障房，健全管理机制，打通在建项目绿色通道<cite id="call_5c3a96c66d38-2"></cite>。

3. 保交楼贷款支持计划与政策性金融工具
- 2023年1月设立2000亿元保交楼贷款支持计划，2024年延续至5月底，配合专项借款形成保交楼合力<cite id="call_e31cee43730e-2"></cite>。

4. 绿色金融支持低碳建筑
- 国务院部署建筑领域节能降碳方案，要求2025年城镇新建建筑全面执行绿色建筑标准，新建超低能耗、近零能耗建筑增长超2亿平方米，既有建筑节能改造增长2亿平方米，建筑可再生能源替代率8%，电力消费占比超55%<cite id="call_74d2161a89ff-1"></cite>。
- 人民银行等七部门强化金融支持绿色低碳发展，资本市场支持绿色项目融资<cite id="call_74d2161a89ff-4"></cite>。

四、导向机制：从“以地为本”到“以人定房”的治理升级
1. 以人定房、以房定地机制
- 2026年将全面实施“以人定房、以房定地”，严控新增住宅用地供应，从源头遏制过剩供给<cite id="call_9278d73deed2-4"></cite>。

2. 城市更新与存量盘活
- 城市更新行动加大实施力度，城中村改造和危旧房改造优化供给结构，推动存量用地转保障房、安置房、宿舍、人才房<cite id="call_9278d73deed2-1"></cite>。

3. 现房销售与预售资金监管
- 全国至少32个省市试点现房销售，预售资金全流程监控要求银行按工程进度拨付，违规房企纳入“黑名单”<cite id="call_9ee054239a08-4"></cite><cite id="call_c153f3280a58-4"></cite>。

4. 保障性住房精准供应
- 优化保障性住房供给，适当减少新建规模，支持收购存量商品房，2024年中央财政补助资金和预算内投资持续发力<cite id="call_9ee054239a08-1"></cite>。

五、未来10年发展路径与关键趋势（2026—2035）
1. 长期主线：构建房地产发展新模式
- 2025年中央经济工作会议明确“着力稳定房地产市场”，2026年政策聚焦控增量、去库存、优供给，城市更新、城中村改造、存量盘活、现房销售、公积金改革、新型金融支持将成为常态<cite id="call_9278d73deed2-1"></cite><cite id="call_9278d73deed2-4"></cite>。

2. 供给端：双轮驱动+存量优先
- 保障性租赁住房持续发力，租赁市场规范化；城中村改造和危旧房改造成为新增供给主力；现房销售和预售资金监管强化交付保障<cite id="call_9ee054239a08-0"></cite><cite id="call_9278d73deed2-1"></cite><cite id="call_9ee054239a08-4"></cite>。

3. 资金端：专项债+政策性工具+绿色金融
- 专项债扩大资本金支持、收购存量转保障房，政策性金融工具保障“三大工程”，绿色金融支持低碳建筑，形成多元低成本资金池<cite id="call_5c3a96c66d38-2"></cite><cite id="call_e31cee43730e-1"></cite><cite id="call_74d2161a89ff-1"></cite>。

4. 金融端：供给侧改革+白名单管理
- 金融监管总局、人民银行、证监会推动供给侧改革，支持“三大工程”，房地产项目“白名单”制度引导融资流向合规主体<cite id="call_e31cee43730e-1"></cite>。

5. 品质端：好房子+全生命周期管理
- 实施房屋与物业服务品质提升工程，建立房屋体检、养老金保险等制度，推动绿色智慧建筑标准<cite id="call_9ee054239a08-3"></cite>。

6. 治理端：以人定地+动态调控
- 以人定房、以房定地机制严控住宅用地，城市政府用足用好调控自主权，因城施策动态响应市场<cite id="call_9278d73deed2-4"></cite>。

结语：动力图谱与预期
- 动力来源：市场调整倒逼转型、政策组合拳止跌回稳、金融供给侧改革、保障性供给扩张、存量盘活与现房销售、品质提升与全生命周期治理。
- 政策框架：从“房住不炒”到“发展新模式”，组合拳+长效机制+城市更新+现房销售+公积金改革+新型金融。
- 资金工具：专项债资本金+收购转保障房+政策性工具+绿色金融支持低碳建筑。
- 导向机制：以人定地控增量、存量优先去库存、现房销售保交付、精准保障优供给。
- 未来10年趋势：新模式常态化、双轮驱动供给、多元低成本资金池、供给侧改革+白名单、好房子标准、以人定地动态调控。

简言之，中国房地产正在从“高杠杆扩张”转向“保交付、稳预期、优供给、促转型”，政策、资金和导向的系统性改革为行业可持续发展提供了明确路径，未来10年将呈现“保障性供给扩张+存量盘活+品质提升+金融供给侧改革+城市更新”并行的有序、良性发展图景。</answer>

problem: 在800V高压/碳化硅电驱/固态电池/分布式驱动等技术迭代加速的窗口期，如何构建覆盖研发制造-使用场景-残值管理的评估体系，量化不同动力系统技术路线（纯电/增程/插混/氢燃料+集中式驱动/分布式驱动）的商业化临界点？

<answer>本报告构建一个覆盖研发制造、使用场景、残值管理的评估体系，量化纯电/增程/插混/氢燃料+集中式驱动/分布式驱动的商业化临界点。评估维度包括：全生命周期成本（TCO）、性能（续航/加速度/加速时间）、效率（系统效率、能耗）、基础设施适配性（充电功率/网络覆盖率）、市场行为（渗透率/用户行为）、残值（电池健康度/二手车溢价），并结合技术路线特征（电压平台、器件、电池化学）进行归因分析。

一、评估体系设计
1. 研发制造维度
- 动力总成成本结构：电驱（电机、电控、减速器/桥）、电池系统（电芯、BMS、模组）、半导体（SiC IGBT/MOSFET）、热管理、电控软件。分布式驱动可降低传动链复杂度并提升功率密度，但集成度要求更高，需权衡开发风险与成本（如电桥重量、冷却设计）<cite id="call_e1099cb9731f-0"></cite><cite id="call_58ee118b46e7-0"></cite>。
- 半导体与电压平台：800V平台通过降低电流减小线缆截面积和损耗，可实现约50%更快的补能（峰值功率）和约15%的能效提升，但会增加约15–20%的功率电子复杂度与成本；SiC器件可使系统效率提升4–6%、续航增加5–10%，功率密度曲线预计从2019年的37 kW/L上升至2027年的100 kW/L，但SiC模块成本仍高于Si IGBT<cite id="call_dd3a7c36052f-0"></cite><cite id="call_b4ab7be27a98-0"></cite><cite id="call_b4ab7be27a98-2"></cite>。
- 电池化学与制造：锂离子电芯成本已从2008年的1,415美元/kWh降至2023年的约139美元/kWh（10万+年产能），但固态电池（SSB）仍处于工厂试点阶段，2026–2027年启动示范车队，2030年后才有望实现大规模低成本量产，当前技术经济障碍（界面稳定性、材料成本）导致其商业化临界点较远<cite id="call_58ee118b46e7-1"></cite><cite id="call_e6c63a3a6cda-0"></cite><cite id="call_e6c63a3a6cda-1"></cite>。
- 分布式驱动（DD）：相比集中式驱动，DD具备更高的控制灵活性、传动效率和空间利用率，但面临耦合非线性、多约束下的扭矩分配与协同控制挑战；实际案例显示电桥重量约120 kg，扭矩密度达67 N·m/kg、功率密度5 kW/kg，但系统复杂度和集成验证成本较高<cite id="call_e1099cb9731f-0"></cite><cite id="call_58ee118b46e7-0"></cite>。

2. 使用场景维度
- 充电与补能：800V平台在理想条件下可支持350+ kW充电，较400V平台快约1.5倍（如IONIQ 5 10–80%约18分钟 vs 400V约45分钟），但需高功率DC快充网络支撑；400V系统因电流高导致更多电阻损耗，限制了超快充经济性<cite id="call_58ee118b46e7-4"></cite><cite id="call_10380310-1"></cite>。
- 能耗与效率：SiC逆变器可提升系统效率4–6%，续航增加5–10%；集中式驱动的电机/电控/减速器总损耗需结合具体平台标定，而DD系统因短传动链通常效率更高，但需控制策略优化<cite id="call_b4ab7be27a98-0"></cite><cite id="call_e1099cb9731f-0"></cite>。
- 用户行为与TCO：欧洲数据显示，BEV在75%的案例中TCO已低于PHEV/REEV，且在燃油价格低至0.38欧元/L时仍具成本优势；插混在市区通勤场景下纯电占比高时经济性较好，但公司用车实测纯电占比仅10–15%，导致燃油成本显著上升；氢燃料电池车（FCEV）在年行驶30万公里、氢价低于5美元/kg时可与BEV持平，备用电源场景下氢价降至3美元/kg可与柴油发电机竞争<cite id="call_1d87b8edd232-0"></cite><cite id="call_457961ba0549-4"></cite>。
- 城市通勤场景：谷电充电下年电费约240元（8,000公里），插混若亏电油耗5.5 L/100 km则年成本达3,520元，凸显BEV在固定充电条件下的经济性优势<cite id="call_480bdb4c126f-3"></cite>。

3. 残值管理维度
- 电池健康与二手车溢价：行业数据显示，BEV电池健康度（SOH）检测存在“注水”现象，实测三年容量损失可达17%（高于厂商宣称的5–8%），影响二手车溢价；SSB因技术新且检测标准不成熟，残值黑洞风险可能更大，需建立独立检测与回购机制<cite id="call_e9b1722d6c80-1"></cite><cite id="call_e9b1722d6c80-0"></cite>。
- 固定资产残值：重型车辆全生命周期模型显示，分布式驱动在购置成本与电耗成本的综合对比中可能更具优势，但需结合具体应用场景（如城市配送 vs 高速长途）<cite id="call_58ee118b46e7-2"></cite>。

二、技术路线商业化临界点量化
1. 纯电驱动（BEV）
- 临界点：800V+SiC平台可使充电时间缩短约1.5倍、能效提升4–6%、续航增加5–10%，但需高功率DC快充网络（>250 kW覆盖率）和高性价比SiC器件；当电池成本降至100美元/kWh以下、800V线缆成本优化（截面积减小）时，800V方案的经济性拐点显现<cite id="call_10380310-1"></cite><cite id="call_b4ab7be27a98-0"></cite><cite id="call_b4ab7be27a98-2"></cite>。
- 市场行为：欧洲TTCO研究显示，BEV在75%的案例中TCO已低于PHEV/REEV，且在燃油价格低至0.38欧元/L时仍具成本优势，2024年小型/城市车已低于ICE，且二手车溢价差距预计2035年前收窄至4%<cite id="call_1d87b8edd232-0"></cite>。
- 基础设施：需加快800V超快充网络建设（如350–400 kW站点），并推动充电时间/效率标准统一，以支撑800V渗透<cite id="call_10380310-1"></cite>。

2. 增程驱动（REEV）
- 临界点：REEV需电池容量约为PHEV的2倍（实测约150 km vs 65 km），以维持纯电占比，但ICE发电效率限制其整体能效；当用户纯电占比低于20%时，REEV燃油经济性优势消失，且TCO高于BEV<cite id="call_357549030-1"></cite><cite id="call_1d87b8edd232-0"></cite>。
- 市场行为：中国早期数据表明REEV实际纯电占比约35%，欧洲公司车纯电占比仅10–15%，表明用户行为与政策激励（如免税/牌照优惠）对REEV经济性影响显著<cite id="call_1d87b8edd232-0"></cite><cite id="call_1d90404eeb5d-3"></cite>。

3. 插电混动（PHEV）
- 临界点：PHEV在城市通勤场景下纯电占比高时经济性较好，但若纯电占比低于15–20%，TCO将高于BEV；当电力碳强度显著低于燃油碳强度时，PHEV可作为过渡方案，但长期看BEV更优<cite id="call_1d87b8edd232-0"></cite><cite id="call_1d90404eeb5d-2"></cite>。
- 基础设施：依赖现有电网与家用充电桩，对公共快充依赖度低，但二手车残值受电池健康度影响较大<cite id="call_480bdb4c126f-3"></cite>。

4. 氢燃料+集中式驱动（FCEV）
- 临界点：FCEV在年行驶30万公里、氢价低于5美元/kg时可与BEV持平，备用电源场景下氢价降至3美元/kg可与柴油发电机竞争；但当前氢价（约5–10美元/kg）和基础设施（加氢站密度）限制其商业化<cite id="call_457961ba0549-4"></cite>。
- 基础设施：需大规模加氢站网络与低成本电解槽，短期内难以普及，适合特定重卡/长途物流场景<cite id="call_457961ba0549-1"></cite>。

5. 分布式驱动（DD）+集中式驱动
- 临界点：DD在短途高频场景（如城市配送）中因高效率和空间利用率更具优势，但需高集成度开发与验证；当电桥功率密度达100 kW/L、冷却技术（如直槽内冷却、碳纤维转子）成熟时，DD经济性拐点显现<cite id="call_e1099cb9731f-0"></cite><cite id="call_58ee118b46e7-0"></cite>。
- 基础设施：对充电依赖度低，适合固定路线/短途场景，但需电驱控制器与整车协同开发能力<cite id="call_e1099cb9731f-0"></cite>。

三、跨维度决策矩阵
| 维度         | BEV                          | PHEV/REEV                     | FCEV                         | DD                          |
|--------------|------------------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| TCO          | 75%场景优于ICE，2035年溢价收窄 | 城市通勤优势，但纯电占比低时劣势 | 氢价<5美元/kg时与BEV持平     | 高集成度开发成本，效率优势  |
| 性能         | 快充/续航/加速优势           | 纯电占比决定，低占比时劣势    | 补能快，但续航受限           | 高控制灵活性，短传动链      |
| 效率         | SiC+800V提升4–6%，续航+5–10% | 纯电占比决定                  | ICE发电效率限制              | 短传动链效率更高            |
| 基础设施     | 需800V超快充网络             | 依赖电网与家用桩               | 加氢站密度低                 | 对充电依赖度低              |
| 残值         | 二手车溢价受电池健康度影响   | 同BEV                        | 技术新，残值黑洞风险         | 高集成度影响残值            |
| 适用场景     | 城市通勤/长途/多场景         | 短途通勤                      | 重卡/长途/备用电源           | 城市配送/固定路线           |

四、行动路线与政策杠杆
1. 研发制造
- 800V+SiC平台：优先布局800V线束/绝缘标准、SiC控制器（含六相拓扑以降低电容应力），通过模块化设计控制SiC成本，目标是2026–2027年实现800V车型量产<cite id="call_10380310-1"></cite><cite id="call_9968655"></cite><cite id="call_b4ab7be27a98-2"></cite>。
- SSB：支持试点工厂与示范车队，聚焦界面稳定性、材料成本与回收标准，目标2030年后实现低成本量产<cite id="call_e6c63a3a6cda-1"></cite>。
- DD：开发集成电桥控制器与热管理，采用直槽内冷却、碳纤维转子等技术，目标2026–2027年实现城市配送车型落地<cite id="call_58ee118b46e7-0"></cite>。

2. 基础设施
- 800V超快充网络：在主要城市/高速服务区部署350–400 kW站点，提升覆盖率至30%以上，支撑800V渗透<cite id="call_10380310-1"></cite>。
- 加氢站：聚焦重卡/长途物流场景，初期建设100–200座示范站，推动电解绿氢成本下降<cite id="call_457961ba0549-4"></cite>。

3. 市场与政策
- TCO激励：对BEV提供购置补贴/牌照优惠，对PHEV/REEV定向补贴（如城市通勤场景），并建立电池健康度独立检测机制以提升残值<cite id="call_1d87b8edd232-0"></cite><cite id="call_e9b1722d6c80-0"></cite>。
- 标准化：统一800V充电协议、SiC控制器接口、DD扭矩分配控制框架，降低兼容性成本<cite id="call_10380310-1"></cite><cite id="call_e1099cb9731f-0"></cite>。

4. 残值管理
- 建立SSB/BEV电池回购与梯次利用标准，推动退役电池在建筑储能中的应用（如46 kWh BESS可显著提升负荷匹配与环境效益）<cite id="call_e4f39adfac70-0"></cite>。

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="BEvs800V performance advantages vs cost trade-offs 2023 2024" search_time="2026年5月10日10时38分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:9"><title>POST-800V ELECTRIC VEHICLES</title><summary>This thesis concentrates on the requirements and implications of post-800 V electric-vehicle (EV) architectures by providing first an independent analysis of the transition from 400 V to 800 V systems. Beginning with an overview of high-voltage powertrain fundamentals, the work systematically reviews the roles and interactions of the battery, inverter, motor, and on-board charger subsystems. A structured literature survey of academic and industry sources identifies the principal benefits of 800 V systems, such as, reduced current requirements, lighter cabling, higher charging power densities, and improved overall efficiency, and contrasts these with the increased insulation demands, component costs, and safety considerations inherent to higher voltages. Quantitative comparisons between representative 400 V and 800 V EV models are conducted, examining metrics such as peak charging rate, energy losses, thermal performance, and system-level mass. The results indicate that 800 V architectures can deliver up to 50 % faster charging and reduce electrical losses by approximately 15 %, while incurring an estimated 15–20 % increase in power-electronics cost and complexity. Based on these findings, the thesis discusses design strategies and technological pathways to mitigate technical and economic barriers and offers guidance for manufacturers and policymakers considering the adoption of post 800 V EV platforms. The conclusions underscore the potential of high-voltage architectures to accelerate EV performance and charging infrastructure development, while highlighting areas for further research in materials, safety standards, and cost optimization.</summary><hostname>LUTPub</hostname><author_list><author name="Wassam Yaseen" affiliation="Lappeenranta–Lahti University of Technology LUT" /></author_list><url>https://lutpub.lut.fi/bitstream/handle/10024/169985/mastersthesis_yaseen_wassam.pdf;jsessionid=3628D66AB017C0521C928E0037BDD4A1?sequence=1</url><publish_time>2025年5月10日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:10"><title>EFFECT OF ELECTRIC VEHICLE BATTERY VOLTAGE (400 VOLT OR 800 VOLT) ON CHARGING TECHNOLOGY</title><summary>With the growth and advancement of electric vehicles (EVs) there has been a sharp focus on the limitations of traditional 400 V battery systems, especially growing focus and demand for ultra-fast charging and advanced ways to tackle the challenge of ultra-fast charging as well as thermal efficiency. This thesis focuses on a review of current technologies and options as well as the technical impact of transitioning from 400 V to 800 V architectures in EVs. The thesis emphasizes how an increase in system voltage impacts infrastructure, charging technology, vehicle performance, and power electronics. A comparative analysis highlights the inefficiencies of 400 V systems at high power levels due to excessive current and thermal stress, while 800 V platforms demonstrate faster charging times, reduced resistive losses, and compatibility with emerging high-power DC fast chargers. Key enabling technologies, including onboard DC-DC converters, SiC-based inverters, and advanced cooling systems, are examined to assess the practical requirements for implementing 800 V systems. The thesis also focuses on currently available options and real-world applications in modern EVs by manufacturers as well as evaluating the adaptability of dual-voltage charging infrastructure. Towards the end, the study considers the future prospects and current barriers associated with emerging 1200 V platforms, focusing on insulation limitations and connector standards. Overall, the research highlights how traction battery architectures help make future EV charging strategies possible and share guidance on building efficient, scalable systems for an electrifying mobility sector.</summary><hostname>LUTPub</hostname><a

<search query="solid state battery commercialization timeline cost 2023 2024 2025 review" search_time="2026年5月10日10时40分星期日"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:57"><title>Solid-State Battery Roadmap 2035+</title><hostname>cdn.motor1.com</hostname><url>https://cdn.motor1.com/pdf-files/fraunhofer-solid-state-battery-report.pdf</url><publish_time>2022年4月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:58"><title>A Comprehensive Analysis of Toyota's European BEV Strategy and the Global Solid-State Battery Landscape</title><summary>1. Executive Summary:
Synthesis of Key Findings and Forward-Looking Analysis
1.1 The Kolin Production and Battery Technology
Toyota's strategic decision to produce battery electric vehicles (BEVs) in Europe, with a target of 100,000 units annually at its Czech Republic plant in Kolin starting in 2028, is a direct response to a changing regulatory and competitive environment.
The report indicates that these initial production vehicles, likely a new electric SUV, will almost certainly not be equipped with solid-state batteries (SSBs). This conclusion is based on a critical analysis of both Toyota's nuanced battery roadmap and the broader challenges facing SSB mass production.
While Toyota has set an ambitious timeline of 2027-2028 for the commercialization of its SSBs, this date likely signifies the start of limited, low-volume production for high-end or specialized applications. A high-volume facility like Kolin, aiming for a 100,000-unit annual target from its inception, would require a proven, cost-effective, and scalable battery technology.
Therefore, the most probable scenario is the deployment of one of Toyota's next-generation liquid-electrolyte batteries, such as the high-performance lithium-ion or cost-effective Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) variants planned for introduction around the same time.
1.2 The Global Status of Solid-State Batteries
The industry is currently in a critical transition phase, moving from laboratory-based research and development to the establishment of factory pilots and low-volume manufacturing.
Many publicly announced timelines for "mass production" are, upon closer inspection, more accurately described as pilot lines or demonstration projects. Key players such as QuantumScape, Solid Power, and Factorial Energy are targeting the launch of these initial production phases and demonstration fleets around 2026-2027.
The primary barriers to true high-volume manufacturing (HVM) remain significant and are dual in nature: economic and technical. The high costs associated with specialized materials and manufacturing processes, coupled with unresolved technical issues like dendrite growth and interface stability, continue to make widespread adoption challenging and delay the achievement of cost parity with conventional lithium-ion batteries.
1.3 Competitive Landscape
A review of the top global BEV producers reveals a varied approach to solid-state technology. While a handful of Chinese manufacturers, notably BYD and CATL, are setting aggressive timelines, many are making a clear distinction between initial "demonstration use" and "large-scale adoption" that is not expected until after 2030.
This demonstrates a more pragmatic view of the technological and economic hurdles. Conversely, legacy automakers like the Volkswagen Group and Stellantis are actively pursuing partnerships with SSB startups to gain a competitive advantage.
Meanwhile, incumbent BEV leaders like Tesla appear to be focused on optimizing existing lithium-ion technology, believing there is still significant room for improvement. Toyota's 2027-2028 timeline for SSB commercialization, while ambitious, must be viewed within the context of these industry-wide challenges, suggesting a cautious strategy where SSBs will be one of several battery options, not the single solution for its entire portfolio.
The "race" for solid-state technology is a multi-stage marathon, with the initial low-volume winners not necessarily becoming the ultimate leaders in mass-market deployment.

Thanks to advances in technology, the four main barriers to switching to a BEV (charging time, range, resale value, costs) are quickly fading in the majority of use cases. Public charging stations target 5-20 minutes recharge; new models launched in 2024 average over 500 km of namelplate autonomy vs. 640 km for ICE; and resale value gaps between BEV and ICE are projected to narrow to 4% by 2035. Total cost of ownership (TCO) are also lower for a BEV than alternatives as of 2025 in 75% of cases in Europe², and BEVs retain a cost advantage even if fuel prices were to fall to 0.38€/L, a price not observed in Europe for two decades.³ Purchasing costs are now also lower for small/city cars (B-segments) than ICE cars, and cheaper than plug-in hybrids (PHEVs) for ICE cars. BEVs achieve superior cost and emissions advantage compared to PHEVs and range-extended EVs (REEVs). Real-world data shows that PHEVs run on electric mode only 10-15% for company cars, far from the 80% initially forecasted. BEVs also tend to cost less to own and drive (640 – 1,600 €/year less than a PHEV for an average driver⁴). REEVs, strongly picking up in China, share the same structural weakness. Early real-world data in China shows they run 35% of the time using the generator. REEVs, often large cars, rely on smaller batteries and use a simple, low-cost generator that would not anchor powertrain jobs in Europe. European OEMs are catching up with imported brands on BEV sales in Europe, launching affordable BEV models⁵, and now accounting for 65% of BEV sales in H1 2025. Targeted investments—from charging value chain to battery manufacturing & recycling—should create about 170,000 direct jobs by 2030. In parallel, charging infrastructure is being rolled out steadily. This working paper presents a fact-based assessment of the future of passenger car powertrains, demonstrating that battery electric vehicles (BEVs) outperform PHEVs, REEVs and ICE for Europe’s light transportation emission targets. The increasing number of retired electric vehicle (EV) batteries, expected from the automotive sector, can match this demand as EV batteries can be used as BESS, considering that they have about 80% of their original energy capacity. In this context, the study aims at examining the system, consisting of a BESS made by retired Li-ion EV batteries, a photovoltaic plant (20 kW) and the electricity grid, that provides the electricity required by an existing nearly net zero residential building (25.000 kWh/year). The goal is to identify the optimal BESS size, expressed as energy capacity, for load match optimization and environmental impacts in a life cycle perspective. A BESS of around 46 kWh of energy capacity allows achieving significant results in terms of load match increase and environmental sustainability. The study includes an environmental assessment combining the load match analysis and the life cycle approach. problem:
(working on LN-based nonlinear photonics):
Possible ways to mitigate the material damage of LN after plasma etching?
final_response:
<think>
We need to produce a structured, data-driven report on mitigating LN material damage after plasma etching. The user works on LN-based nonlinear photonics, so they’re likely concerned with etch-induced optical quality loss, domain inversion, subsurface defects, and waveguide fabrication. Based on the prior tool calls, we already have relevant sources: an ECR plasma treatment study showing reduced subsurface defects and polarity-dependent charge behavior (Ferroelectrics 2004), a redeposition-free ICP etch workflow (PMC 2023), an HBr plasma ALPE example (2025 Chinese site), RIE process notes advocating oxygen addition to reduce redeposition (DTIC 1997), and a LN-on-insulator review highlighting parameter optimization and by-product redeposition as key issues (AVS 2024). We'll structure the report with background, damage mechanisms, and mitigation strategies backed by these sources, adding citations at the end of each sentence. We'll avoid speculative claims and focus on documented practices and effects. We'll also note when thermal treatment or cladding is used, as in the PMC example, and the trade-offs (e.g., ARDE in ICP vs. bromine-based ALPE). We'll ensure each mitigation method is tied to a specific source and include practical guidance (e.g., oxygen addition, ICP parameter workflow, ECR conditioning, ALPE chemistries, and post-etch cleaning). We'll conclude with a summary table for quick reference.
</think>

<answer>Structuring the mitigation of plasma-etched LN damage

Background and context
- LN is sensitive to surface and subsurface defects, charges, and contamination due to its ferroelectric and nonlinear properties; plasma etching can induce these issues, especially in integrated photonic waveguide fabrication. <cite id="call_095320f06486-0"></cite><cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-4"></cite>

Damage mechanisms observed after plasma etching
- Subsurface layer charging and structure defects; domain polarity correlates with subsurface charge sign, and defects can decrease after plasma treatment. <cite id="call_095320f06486-0"></cite>
- Micro-masking from material redeposition and limited mask selectivity at deep etches; redeposition can degrade sidewall quality and complicate patterning. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-1"></cite>
- By-product redeposition is a common issue in RIE; increasing oxygen flow improves volatile by-product formation and reduces redeposition. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-3"></cite>
- Etch parameters (e.g., ICP power, gas mixtures, pressure) and mask durability strongly influence etch quality and optical performance. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-4"></cite>

Mitigation strategies with supporting evidence and practical guidance

1. Plasma conditioning to modify surface states and subsurface defects
- Electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) microwave plasma treatment reduces subsurface structure defects and can alter subsurface charging, potentially improving long-term stability and optical quality. This conditioning is compatible with ferroelectric LN and may be applied post-etch. <cite id="call_095320f06486-0"></cite>
- Practical note: ECR conditioning can be integrated after etching to remove a defective surface layer or neutralize subsurface charges; monitor pyroelectric effects due to heating during conditioning. <cite id="call_095320f06486-0"></cite>

2. Minimize redeposition through plasma chemistry and process optimization
- Increase oxygen content in RIE to promote volatile by-products; this reduces redeposition and improves sidewall quality. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-3"></cite>
- Practical note: Adjust O2/etch gas ratios to shift the plasma chemistry toward volatile by-products; document how oxygen addition affects etch rate and anisotropy for your geometry. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-3"></cite>
- Use bromine-based chemistries (e.g., HBr) for atomic-layer plasma etching (ALPE) to achieve redeposition-free etching with vertical sidewalls and no wide‑aspect‑ratio dependence (ARDE), even for sub‑300 nm gaps. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-0"></cite>
- Practical note: Bromine-based ALPE provides precise depth control and isotropic redeposition behavior; pair with H2 or HBr/BCl3/Ar sequences for pattern transfer and clean sidewalls. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-0"></cite>

3. Achieve redeposition‑free inductively coupled plasma (ICP) etching
- A systematic workflow can identify parameter sets (power, pressure, gas mix) that suppress micro‑masking and achieve redeposition‑free etching across plasma systems; this reduces the need for wet cleaning. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-1"></cite>
- Practical note: Characterize your ICP system’s etch window and optimize for minimal redeposition; validate mask selectivity and sidewall quality for your waveguide dimensions. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-1"></cite>

4. Post‑etch cleaning and mask removal
- Buffered HF etch can remove residual masks without additional thermal treatment or cladding deposition, though thermal annealing and polymer cladding have been shown to improve optical quality in some cases. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-2"></cite>
- Practical note: Choose a post‑etch cleaning chemistry (e.g., buffered HF) that balances mask removal efficiency with minimal etching of the LN substrate; consider thermal annealing or cladding if optical quality is compromised. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-2"></cite>

5. Etch parameter optimization and process control
- Reactive‑ion etching requires careful optimization of substrate heating, mask durability, and gas chemistries; systematic tuning of these parameters can mitigate defects and improve waveguide quality. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-4"></cite>
- Practical note: Use design‑of‑experiments or iterative testing to find the optimal heating, gas flow ratios, and RF power for your LN thickness and feature geometry; monitor sidewall roughness and etch uniformity. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-4"></cite>

Summary of mitigation methods and their evidence
| Strategy | Evidence and rationale | Practical guidance |
|---------|------------------------|-------------------|
| ECR plasma conditioning | Reduces subsurface structure defects and modifies subsurface charging; domain polarity correlates with charge sign. | Apply post‑etch; monitor heating effects; may improve long‑term stability. |
| Increase oxygen in RIE | Promotes volatile by‑products; reduces redeposition and improves sidewalls. | Adjust O2/etch gas ratios; document effects on etch rate and anisotropy. |
| Bromine‑based ALPE | Achieves redeposition‑free etching with vertical sidewalls and no ARDE even at sub‑300 nm gaps. | Use HBr chemistry; pair with H2 or HBr/BCl3/Ar sequences for clean sidewalls. |
| Redeposition‑free ICP workflow | Systematic parameter selection suppresses micro‑masking and minimizes wet cleaning. | Characterize your ICP system; optimize for minimal redeposition and mask selectivity. |
| Post‑etch cleaning | Buffered HF removes masks; thermal annealing/cladding can improve optical quality. | Choose cleaning chemistry; consider annealing/cladding if optical quality is compromised. |
| Etch parameter optimization | Substrate heating, mask durability, and gas chemistries must be tuned for waveguide quality. | Use iterative testing; monitor sidewall roughness and uniformity. |

Additional considerations
- Domain inversion and subsurface defects can affect optical performance and charge behavior; conditioning and cleaning steps should be validated for your device design. <cite id="call_095320f06486-0"></cite>
- When using ICP or RIE, balance redeposition suppression with etch rate and anisotropy; bromine‑based ALPE offers a cleaner trade‑off for sub‑micron gaps. <cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-0"></cite><cite id="call_910a0474ad0c-3"></cite>

By combining plasma conditioning, optimized chemistry and power settings, and careful post‑etch cleaning, LN material damage from plasma etching can be effectively mitigated while preserving optical quality for nonlinear photonic devices.</answer>

<answer>Title: Price Dynamics and Interannual Variability of Chub Mackerel (Scomber japonicus) in Major Pacific Rim Aquatic Markets, Linked to Oceanographic Regime Shifts and Fishery Economics

Overview and scope
This report synthesizes available data on interannual and decadal variability in chub mackerel landings and biomass around Japan, associated shifts in market prices across major Pacific Rim aquatic markets, and changes in size/weight distributions. It links these patterns to oceanographic regime shifts and fisheries responses (fleet expansion mismatch, overcapacity), and outlines implications for fishery economics and marine resource quality. The evidence is drawn from fisheries science reviews, FAO reports, and Japanese wholesale market price/quantity records. Where direct price series for specific chub mackerel grades are limited, broader market context is used. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite><cite id="call_dbbc8b0b7f5f-2"></cite><cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite><cite id="call_20b8357c4fe1-4"></cite>

Oceanographic context and regime shifts
- Decadal-scale variability in small pelagic catches around the Japanese Archipelago, including prominent species replacements, has long been associated with basin-scale climate/ocean variability, most notably the 1988/89 regime shift. This shift marked a major transition in dominant pelagic species from sardine toward anchovy and, at times, mackerel. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite>
- Hypothetical mechanisms for recruitment variability emphasize early survival as a key driver of population fluctuations, with regime shifts and climate change as critical external controls. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite>

Catch, biomass, and fleet dynamics
- Chub mackerel fisheries in Japan are dominated by purse seine, with large/medium and medium/small configurations. The reliance on purse seine has shaped landings and market supply patterns. <cite id="call_dbbc8b0b7f5f-2"></cite>
- In Kuril waters, analyses of fleet operations show that purse seine efficiency varies with fish schooling behavior and vessel configurations; recommendations for optimal seine use (e.g., coupler vs. fish pump) reflect efforts to align technology with resource conditions. <cite id="call_f9b90f839f1b-0"></cite>
- Overinvestment in larger purse seine fleets during the 1980s, combined with poor ocean productivity following the 1988/89 regime shift, created excess capacity that suppressed recovery of sardine and chub mackerel stocks during the 1990s and early 2000s. Recovery since the mid-2000s has occurred via strong year classes and reduced exploitation rates. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite>

Price dynamics in major Pacific Rim aquatic markets
- Japan: Tokyo Metropolitan Market (TMM) price/quantity reports for the 2010s indicate monthly and seasonal fluctuations in saba (which includes chub mackerel) prices and volumes, consistent with the decadal-scale variability described in the fisheries science review. <cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite><cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite>
- A blog compiling recent sliced saba (chub mackerel) prices in Japan shows an average of around ¥154 per 100 g in November 2025, with a range from a 2021 low of ¥105 to a 2025 high of ¥154, reflecting interannual variability and market conditions. <cite id="call_20b8357c4fe1-4"></cite>
- Auction context: The late 2010s saw rising prices for large tuna at Toyosu’s New Year “Ichibanma” auction, with a 2013 record of ¥155.4 million for a 222-kg fish and a 2024 January record of ~$750,000 for bluefin tuna. While these are tuna-specific, they illustrate the broader market dynamics and price sensitivity to quality and timing that also affect premium mackerel products. <cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite>
- Ehime/Kuril link: Although direct price records for Ehime chub mackerel destined to San Francisco are sparse, a general guide notes that Pacific chub mackerel (Scomber japonicus) appears in international seafood listings with price ranges (e.g., $0.70–1.50/kg on Alibaba), and a blog summarizes broader price trends for Japanese mackerel. These sources suggest that regional supply conditions and oceanographic regimes influence export pricing, but specific Ehime–San Francisco price series are not available in the retrieved evidence. <cite id="call_0d567f818980-3"></cite><cite id="call_0d567f818980-4"></cite>

Interannual variability in size/weight and biological quality
- Size/weight at capture and market are closely tied to early survival and recruitment strength, which are themselves modulated by regime shifts and climate. Periods of strong year classes (e.g., mid-2000s onward) correlate with recovery and improved resource quality, while weak recruitment and density-dependent collapse mechanisms (e.g., in Far Eastern sardine) provide a parallel narrative for mackerel. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite><cite id="call_f9b90f839f1b-1"></cite>
- Seasonal and interannual changes in market grades (e.g., sliced vs. whole) reflect shifts in fish condition and schooling behavior linked to ocean conditions. <cite id="call_20b8357c4fe1-4"></cite>

Fishery economics and market linkages
- The mismatch between fleet investments (1980s purse seine expansion) and poor productivity after the 1988/89 regime shift exemplifies how oceanographic changes can drive overcapacity and economic overexploitation, with long-term impacts on price and supply. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite>
- Price variability at wholesale markets (e.g., TMM) and auction records (e.g., Toyosu) underscores the sensitivity of mackerel economics to both biological conditions (recruitment, size) and market timing, with implications for small-scale fisheries and value chains. <cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite><cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite>

Conclusion and implications
- Chub mackerel price dynamics and interannual variability in size/weight across Pacific Rim markets are strongly shaped by decadal oceanographic regime shifts and fisheries responses (fleet structure, exploitation rates). Historical patterns show that mismatches between capital investment and environmental productivity can lead to overcapacity and depressed prices, while strong year classes and reduced pressure can drive recovery and improved resource quality. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite><cite id="call_dbbc8b0b7f5f-2"></cite>
- Market records from Tokyo and blogs on recent saba prices provide empirical grounding for the relationship between biological conditions and price, while auction data illustrate broader price sensitivity and timing effects. <cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite><cite id="call_20b8357c4fe1-4"></cite><cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite>
- Although direct Ehime–San Francisco price records are not available in the retrieved evidence, general seafood price listings and market dynamics suggest that regional supply and ocean regimes influence export pricing, consistent with the broader patterns observed in Japan. <cite id="call_0d567f818980-3"></cite><cite id="call_0d567f818980-4"></cite>

Data gaps and uncertainty
- Direct price series for Ehime chub mackerel destined to San Francisco or specific grades of chub mackerel in international markets are not available in the retrieved evidence. <cite id="call_0d567f818980-3"></cite><cite id="call_0d567f818980-4"></cite>
- Detailed size/weight time series for chub mackerel across markets are limited to biological and fisheries science syntheses; local market records provide some seasonal and interannual context but not full cohort-level variability. <cite id="call_82e2b1c54d6a-1"></cite><cite id="call_cbc89da6b7f4-2"></cite><cite id="call_20b8357c4fe1-4"></cite>

This synthesis provides a data-driven framework for understanding how high-quality marine biological resources, aquatic markets, fishery economics, and the marine environment are interconnected in chub mackerel systems across the Pacific Rim. Further work could fill the gaps by compiling detailed grade-specific price series and cohort-level size/weight records across markets and fisheries.</answer>

Abstract
Population dynamics of small pelagic fishes (SPF) and their management in Japan were reviewed for Japanese sardine Sardinops melanostictus, Japanese anchovy Engraulis japonicus, chub mackerel Scomber japonicus, and Pacific saury Cololabis saira. The catch and biomass of SPF generally showed decadal-scale variability with prominent species replacements since the 1900s. The causes of species replacements were generally associated with climatic/oceanic variability, particularly “regime shifts,” of which the 1988/89 regime shift was the most influential since the 1970s. Variability in the early survival rate is a key factor for population fluctuations, and the proposed hypothetical mechanisms of recruitment variability are summarized herein. Although overfishing during the 1990s and early 2000s prevented the recovery of Pacific stocks of sardine and chub mackerel, they have been recovering since the mid-2000s owing to strong year classes and reduced exploitation rates. The fundamental cause of overfishing was derived from a mismatch between investments in larger purse seine fleets during the 1980s and poor ocean productivity since the 1988/89 regime shift, when dominant SPF began to shift from sardine to anchovy. Recommendations for fisheries management of SPF around the Japanese Archipelago are proposed, considering climate change and naturally and drastically changing SPF populations.
Keywords Japanese sardine · Japanese anchovy · Chub mackerel · Pacific saury · Population dynamics · Regime shift · Species replacements · Fisheries management
Introduction
Population dynamics and Japan’s fishery management of the principal small pelagic fishes (SPF) around the Japanese Archipelago were reviewed on the basis of available information, including long-term trajectories of commercial catch, biomass, spawning stock biomass (SSB), recruitment, recruitment per spawning stock biomass (RPS, No./kg), fishing mortality coefficient \((F)\) , and exploitation rate (ER, catch weight/biomass). Potential mechanisms of population fluctuations of target SPF including the effects of “regime shifts” (Kawasaki 2013) and climate change were also summarized. Finally, recommendations for fisheries management of SPF
around the Japanese Archipelago were proposed. The target stocks reviewed are the Pacific and Tsushima Current stocks of Japanese sardine Sardinops melanostictus and chub mackerel Scomber japonicus; the Pacific, Seto Inland Sea, and Tsushima Current stocks of Japanese anchovy Engraulis japonicus; and Pacific saury Cololabis saira, which is considered the only stock over the North Pacific Ocean and its marginal seas (Table 1, Fig. 1). Decadal-scale alternation in the dominant species is known as “species replacements” (Matsuda et al. 1992; Barange et al. 2009).
